items.text:
I do really enjoy the game and can play it for hours. However, the fact that I have to make sure I save every 5-10 minutes just so I don't lose a ton of progress due to bugs or just random jank is a big issue. If they had focused on bug fixes and improving the issues that are in the content already I feel like I could recommend it more to others.

I stopped playing after logging over 100 hours due to the fire update in EA, it made the game unplayable really with the amount of issues it came with. They seem to be pushing adding more content but the base of the game is just lacking so adding the extras is just like putting glitter on dirt.

Its fine to play right now but I've already had save files corrupted and deaths due to bugs/random AI. This is during the 30 hours I have put in after release. My character will still walk out into space with no helmet on which was supposed to be fixed a while ago and storage has to all be done manually. Your items don't get registered properly whether that is during task or otherwise: Batteries will be taken out of the chargers for no reason, they will stop doing everything after swapping batteries when needed and wont restart the tasks, refuses to stack items in bags and just goes one by one, character is highly unreliable I cant even get other crew due to the issues I have with one.

Its not player friendly. It can be played but I don't think majority of gamers would enjoy this game especially not as is. It can be fun but once you get killed from your ship randomly going hyper speed for no reason it becomes annoying. If they fixed the UI and focused more on the original content I think it would be worth playing. I cant recommend it in its current state. They do do regular fixes but they also add more problems by adding more content. I haven't tried the bounty system or races because I'm not confident they even work.

Buy it if you can stand jank and slog. Otherwise stay away for a few more years until its either fully threshed out or development quits.
items.text_zh:
我真的很喜欢这款游戏，可以玩上好几个小时。然而，我必须确保每5到10分钟就保存一次，以免因为bug或随机的故障而丢失大量进度，这是个很大的问题。如果他们专注于修复bug并改进现有内容中的问题，我觉得我会更愿意推荐给别人。

在早期访问的火焰更新后，我玩了超过100小时就停止玩了，它带来的大量问题真的让游戏变得没法玩。他们似乎在推动添加更多内容，但游戏的基础本身就很欠缺，所以添加额外内容就像是在泥土上撒亮片。

现在玩起来还行，但我已经遇到过存档损坏以及因bug/随机AI导致的死亡。这是在我发布后投入的30小时里发生的。我的角色仍然会不戴头盔走进太空，这本来早就该修复了，而且存储必须全部手动完成。你的物品无法正确注册，无论是在任务中还是其他情况下：电池会无缘无故从充电器中被取出，在需要时更换电池后它们会停止做所有事情，不会重新开始任务，拒绝将物品堆叠在包里，只是一件一件地放，角色非常不可靠，我甚至无法获得其他船员，因为我在一个角色上就遇到了这些问题。

它对玩家不友好。可以玩，但我认为大多数玩家不会喜欢这款游戏，尤其是现在这个样子。它可能很有趣，但一旦你的飞船无缘无故突然超高速飞行导致你死亡，就变得很烦人。如果他们修复了UI并更专注于原有内容，我认为它值得一玩。在目前的状态下我无法推荐它。他们确实定期修复，但同时也通过添加更多内容带来了更多问题。我还没试过赏金系统或竞速，因为我不确定它们是否能正常工作。

如果你能忍受故障和苦差事就买吧。否则再等几年，直到它要么完全打磨好，要么开发停止。

Игра в целом классная, особенно для тех, кто любит что то создавать или собирать из хлама и смотреть, как груда мусора превращается в самодостаточную крепость со всем. Но она будто пустая? Просто по примерам:

Плюсы:

1)Атмосферность 
2)Идея выпустить Плюшкина на максимум
3)Собирать из огрызка мега бубылду или реставрировать
4)Система прогрессии (Навыки, инструменты, разные комнаты и тд)
5)Чувство приключения, летать по большой системе (Но пустоватой)

Минусы:

1)Интерфейс, конечно, та еще прикормка. Даже спустя столько времени иногда жжет
2)Нпс вроде есть, но зачем они? Непонятно. Опять же сравнение: В мире риса пешка будет делать что то по команде и сама тащить на склад, производить и тд. Здесь же - если вы наймете нпс - да, плюс пара рук, но в чем беда то? Если не укажете каждый параметр чертового склада и не поставите автозадачу навсегда  - нпс просто будет существовать
3)Бесполезные взаимодействия. Ощущение что просто ради надо. Вроде болтаете и все такое, но часто вы несете чушь (Просто нет выбора сделать что то другое), так и к тому же это бесполезно. Текст ради текста
4)Мало компонентов. Опять же мир риса: Начал с лука - закончил энерговинтовкой, но до неё более десятка разного выбора. А тут: Двигатель от жиги или премиальная PUMP♂♂♂. Типа просто черное и белое и так почти со всем
5)Нечасто, но....: [spoiler] Вы можете иметь десять лет опыта пилотирования, но на вас со скоростью в 1 км/с поприветствует сборщик дереликта. Особенно у станций [/spoiler]
6) 5 пункт и с полицаями связан: [spoiler] У вас все легально? Дай посмотрю. Эти шизоиды на скорости разгоняются в вас как в гта и потом вы, полицай летите куда то. Ждете, пока он ответит и высок риск забубениться в дереликт. Отстыковаться нет возможности чтобы это исправить во время процесса. Спасибо папаша за парковку на планету со скоростью 174м/с. Решает вопрос: ускоренный допрос свинцом [/spoiler]
7)Рутина. Да, хоть я и похвалил за сборку, но тут буквально разбор ради разбора, чтобы получить деньги, но ради чего? Виза там? Шрамы убрать после прошлой перепалки? Ну наверное да, но спорное блюдо

Итог: Игра сырая, но если закрывать глаза на многое то, что надо исправлять, доделывать или удалять - сойдет

游戏整体来说很酷，尤其是对于那些喜欢创造或从破烂中拼凑东西，并看着一堆垃圾变成自给自足的堡垒的人来说。但它好像很空洞？举个例子：

优点：

1）氛围感
2）把普柳什金发挥到极致的主意
3）用残骸拼出超级大宝贝或进行修复
4）成长系统（技能、工具、各种房间等等）
5）冒险感，在一个大星系里飞行（但有点空）

缺点：

1）界面，那真是够呛。即使过了这么久，有时还是让人火大
2）NPC好像有，但他们有什么用？不清楚。再对比一下：在《大米世界》里，棋子会按命令做事，自己把东西拖到仓库、生产等等。而这里——如果你雇了NPC——是的，多了几只手，但问题在哪？如果你不指定该死的仓库的每一个参数，不永久设置自动任务——NPC就只是存在而已
3）无用的互动。感觉只是为了有而有。好像在聊天之类的，但经常你在说废话（只是没有选择做别的事），而且这还没用。为了文本而文本
4）组件太少。还是《大米世界》：从弓开始——最后到能量螺旋枪，但中间有十多种不同选择。而这里：日古利发动机或高级PUMP♂♂♂。就像只有黑与白，几乎一切都这样
5）不常发生，但……：[spoiler] 你可能拥有十年飞行经验，但一个残骸收集者会以1公里/秒的速度来跟你打招呼。尤其是在空间站附近 [/spoiler]
6）第5点也和警察有关：[spoiler] 你一切合法？让我看看。这些疯子像在GTA里一样加速朝你冲过来，然后你，警察，飞向某处。等着他回应，而且撞上残骸的风险很高。过程中没法脱离来修正。谢谢老爹以174米/秒的速度停到星球上。解决问题的方法：用铅弹加速审讯 [/spoiler]
7）例行公事。是的，虽然我夸了拼装，但这里字面意义上是为了拆解而拆解，为了赚钱，但为了什么？签证？把上次争吵后的伤疤去掉？嗯，大概是的，但这是道有争议的菜

总结：游戏很生涩，但如果对很多需要修复、完善或删除的东西睁一只眼闭一只眼——还凑合

I tried a session years ago (around 5 hrs). UI gave some problems, so I decided to put it off, until they finished the game. Well, it's 1.0, another 5 hrs, and oh boy.

While some of the UI issues have gotten better, UI is still illegible in many ways. Why are some items "pristine" and others not?  It obviously isn't item durability, as I have seen pristine items that have been torn apart down to 30% or less. Repairing it to full, 100% doesn't make it either. No rhyme or reason. Then there is how little oversight one has over what each stat does, what your traits do, what your skills do, etc. Sure I can see that over time I do repairs quicker, I install and uninstall items quicker, after some time. But there is nothing telling me why that is. If not for the wiki, I would have no clue what "security threshold" even means.

Speaking of the wiki, it felt like a shot in the nuts, when I discovered that a 1.0 game has so little variety. Ok, you upgrade from a screwdriver to a power tool. What's next? This is 50 years in the future. The one upgrade path, that is somewhat fully developed is the one that is about structure cutting. You go from a hacksaw, to an angle grinder, to a laser torch. Everything else? 2 or even just 1 tool only. The PDA neglect is the worst part of it. There are multiple cartriges that you are supposed to be able to slot in. Two slots only though. But over 5 cards. So you are stuck constantly switching around, depending on what you need to be able to see at that moment. These are just the tools you use directly.  

What about the ship? You use the same nav console that EVERYONE USES. There is only one. You use the exact same thruster, so on and so forth. There are only two items that actually have some variety: sensors and floors/walls. You are able to choose from around 10 sensors and there are, what feels like, over 40+ floor tiles. You also get some choice in clothing (which doesn't matter, because you spend so much time doing EVA anyways, thus you aren't seeing it). To be clear, this wouldn't be an issue, if everyone item wasn't branded with a manufacturer label. Rimworlod has one console and nobody cares. But when you have "Polaris "Standard Navigation Console" Nav Station" as your nav console, well then suddenly it becomes a question of why nobody else is in that business.  There are multiple tool businesses, why not multiple nav consoles?

Overall game progression feels grindy and tedious, while also being rather straightforward and linear. Would not recommend.
items.text_zh:
我几年前试玩过一次（大约5小时）。UI出了一些问题，所以我决定推迟，等他们完成游戏再说。好吧，现在是1.0版，又玩了5小时，我的天哪。

虽然一些UI问题有所改善，但UI在很多方面仍然难以辨认。为什么有些物品是“完好”的，而另一些不是？这显然不是物品耐久度，因为我见过被拆解到30%或更低的完好物品。把它修到满，100%也不行。毫无规律可言。然后是对每个属性做什么、你的特质做什么、你的技能做什么等等，几乎没有监督。当然，我能看到随着时间推移，我修理得更快，安装和卸载物品也更快。但没有任何东西告诉我为什么。如果不是因为wiki，我根本不知道“安全阈值”是什么意思。

说到wiki，当我发现一个1.0游戏的变化如此之少时，感觉就像蛋上挨了一枪。好吧，你从螺丝刀升级到电动工具。接下来呢？这是50年后的未来。唯一一条某种程度上完整开发的升级路径，是关于结构切割的那条。你从钢锯，到角磨机，再到激光炬。其他一切呢？只有2个甚至只有1个工具。对PDA的忽视是最糟糕的部分。有多个卡带，你本应能够插入。但只有两个插槽。却有超过5张卡。所以你只能根据当时需要看到什么而不断切换。这些还只是你直接使用的工具。

那飞船呢？你使用的是每个人都使用的同一个导航控制台。只有一个。你使用完全相同的推进器，等等等等。只有两样物品真正有一些变化：传感器和地板/墙壁。你可以从大约10种传感器中选择，还有感觉超过40多种的地板砖。你在服装上也有一些选择（这无关紧要，因为你花那么多时间做EVA，所以你看不到它）。说清楚点，如果每件物品没有都贴上制造商标签，这不会是个问题。Rimworld有一个控制台，没人在乎。但当你的导航控制台是“Polaris‘标准导航控制台’导航站”时，好吧，那突然就变成了为什么没有其他公司做这个生意的问题。有多个工具企业，为什么不能有多个导航控制台？

整体游戏进程感觉既肝又乏味，同时还相当直接和线性。不推荐。

observations.evidence: UI is still illegible in many ways
observations.evidence_zh: UI在很多方面仍然难以辨认

items.text:
i get why this game has mixed reviews. there is some truly honest to god awful ♥♥♥♥ in it. the developer quips need to just be removed (this isn't a marvel movie, i'm trying to take your serious setting seriously lol), the UI/UX/item management needs drastic improvement, docking and undocking takes way more clicks that it should, insane lack of verisimilitude for a 1.0 release (two bags the entirety of the game. you expect me to believe this literally solar system spanning society is reliant on TWO types of bags and theyre not even actual backpacks?) the tutorial ends abruptly after touching on just the basics. that last point is the most devastating, just like Kitfoxs other game Neo-Scavenger, most players are going to (reasonably) get caught up in the minutiae without ever getting to the "game proper" which is everything outside of the first area.

the learning curve is steep and barely visible without context, but its there. each major location across the solar system is designed to teach the player something. k-leg, the first major area the player spends time in includes the aforementioned tutorial, but it doesn't explain ANYTHING about shipbuilding which is arguably what the entire area is supposed to be teaching you since you literally won't be able to get anywhere (not even to the outer reaches of the k-leg boneyard) without at least modifying your starter ship. that is the most egregious thing about this game. because if you can get past k-leg, then you really get to the bulk of the game.

inner system travel teaches you how to use a torch drive both manually and with plots. venus introduces an entirely new atmospheric ship building system and ship racing. ceres makes you forget everything you've learned and build entirely for ship combat or mining. all of these areas are fun and even the story is kind of engaging... but it's all hidden behind a starting area that doesn't teach you the mechanic it requires you to master in order to "beat" it.  that being said, if you put in the time and learn all these systems, it's great. nothing like coursing through the void beating your meat. no seriously, beat your meat while in deep space and see what happens.
items.text_zh:
我明白为什么这款游戏评价褒贬不一了。里面确实有一些真他妈糟糕的玩意儿。开发者的俏皮话就该直接删掉（这又不是漫威电影，我可是在认真对待你那严肃的设定啊哈哈），UI/UX/物品管理需要大幅改进，对接和脱离对接需要的点击次数远超应有，对于一个1.0正式版来说，拟真度低得离谱（整个游戏就两种包。你指望我相信这个横跨整个太阳系的社会就靠两种包，而且它们甚至都不是真正的背包？）教程在只讲了最基础的东西之后就戛然而止。最后一点是最要命的，就像Kitfox的另一款游戏Neo-Scavenger一样，大多数玩家会（合理地）陷入细枝末节中，永远到不了“真正的游戏”部分，也就是第一个区域之外的一切。

学习曲线很陡峭，没有背景的话几乎看不出来，但它确实存在。太阳系中的每个主要地点都旨在教会玩家一些东西。k-leg，玩家花时间待的第一个主要区域，包含了前面提到的教程，但它完全没有解释任何关于造船的内容，而按理说这整个区域本该教你的就是这个，因为如果不至少改装你的初始飞船，你 literally 哪儿都去不了（连k-leg废船场的边缘都到不了）。这是这款游戏最离谱的地方。因为如果你能熬过k-leg，那你才真正接触到游戏的主体。

内太阳系旅行教你如何手动和使用航线来操作火炬驱动器。金星引入了一套全新的大气层内造船系统和飞船竞速。谷神星让你忘掉学过的一切，完全围绕飞船战斗或采矿来建造。所有这些区域都很有趣，甚至剧情也算引人入胜……但这一切都藏在一个起始区域后面，而这个区域并不教你它要求你掌握才能“通关”的机制。话虽如此，如果你投入时间学会所有这些系统，那就很棒。没有什么比在虚空中穿行打飞机更爽的了。不，说真的，在深空里打飞机看看会发生什么。

items.text:
With how addicting the simulation (and the potential it motivates you with) is, it's a disappointment in the execution. 

Pathfinding errors between two ships forcing the player to babysit huge workloads instead of the creative design game I would rather play.
Walk commands that fail instead of picking a nearest location. 
Needing to look for your characters shoes because autotask (which isn't even on) ripped through some inventories on an EVA warpath. 
Triple beep error sound that has lost all its meaning by being played just because the game is paused when a valid walk command is issued. 
The massive performance hiccups that are so regular it suggests a complete lack of hardware sympathy.
Installs that wont pass because something loose is in the designated walkway tile, even though loose items don't block walkways. 
Constantly fighting with popup inventories that clearly respect no god. 
A Quick Action Bar that impressively adds more hurdle in your way by being designed like a wack-a-mole game.
A proximity alarm that wont stay muted even if you rip out the alarm module on the Nav Station you're linked to.
Have your Nav Station backwards and your ship will flip around when you undock, but not from OKLG.
Tool-tip names and portraits showing the wrong person in your crew even after they're no longer with you. 
The list goes on and on. 

Is this whole simulation just taped together with shortcuts? This game takes _way_ too much time to play for lacking so much QoL on release. The experience you give the player _is_ the whole game. You need more discipline in programming the invariants of your fundamental systems. You need a more critical eye for interaction and readability. I _want_ deep systems. I don't want to work so hard to experience them. I don't want to learn a thousand different workarounds just to play a game. I want to recommend this game but I can't recommend the experience I've had with it so far.
items.text_zh:
模拟如此令人上瘾（以及它激励你的潜力），在执行上却令人失望。

两艘船之间的寻路错误迫使玩家照看巨大的工作量，而不是我更愿意玩的创意设计游戏。
行走命令失败，而不是选择最近的位置。
需要寻找你的角色的鞋子，因为自动任务（甚至都没开启）在EVA征途中撕毁了一些库存。
三声哔哔错误音效已经失去了所有意义，因为当发出有效的行走命令时游戏暂停就会播放它。
大规模的性能卡顿如此规律，表明完全缺乏对硬件的体谅。
安装无法通过，因为指定走道格子里有松散物品，尽管松散物品不会阻挡走道。
不断与明显不尊重任何神明的弹出式库存作斗争。
一个快速操作栏，通过设计得像打地鼠游戏一样，令人印象深刻地在你前进的道路上增加了更多障碍。
一个接近警报，即使你拔掉你所连接的导航站上的警报模块，它也不会保持静音。
把你的导航站装反了，你的船在脱离对接时会翻转，但不会从OKLG。
工具提示名称和头像显示你船员中的错误人物，即使他们已经不再和你在一起。
这样的例子不胜枚举。

整个模拟是不是只是用捷径拼凑起来的？这款游戏在发布时缺乏如此多的生活质量功能，却要花费_太多_时间来玩。你给玩家的体验_就是_整个游戏。你需要更有纪律地编程你的基础系统的不变量。你需要对交互和可读性有更批判的眼光。我_想要_深度系统。我不想为了体验它们而如此努力。我不想仅仅为了玩一个游戏而学习一千种不同的变通方法。我想推荐这款游戏，但我不能推荐我迄今为止所经历的体验。

1.0, but still incredibly buggy. Give it a bit.

Pretty decent storylines, or at-least what they're consisting of so far is pretty good. The game, even after 'full release' is basically Bethesda-coded, with bugs that range from minor annoyances to "I had to restart my 60 hour save because of this ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ bug." And some of the worst combat I've seen in a game like this. 

Ideas to make the game less of a misery:
-Fix the horrible bug that disables your ability to actually construct anything, despite having the tools and items to do so
-Get rid of the annoying loading splash screen (Why do we gotta' click? Just load.)
-Fix the god-awful lag/stuttering/freezing issues
-Fix the scroll-wheel's zoom rubber banding after exiting a menu.
-Fix the horrible PDA files ui
-Fix the strangely low spawn rate for Heavy Water containers.
-Make it obvious which PDA is yours in the files menu
-Make it impossible for police to warrant you when a ship's transponder is off.
-O2 tank refill auto-shutoff
-Player-placed items REMAIN the player's property. (That's my battery charger, stop arresting me because I picked it up.)
-Allow docking at stations while towing a vessel
-Make most containers on-board ships and station private property so I can't just yoink someone's weed cigs.
-Different ways of reaching other planets without having to grind for RL days to get a Torch Drive.
-More space horror
-Add the transit kiosks in a tram-like station so we aren't just teleporting to other parts of stations.
-More advancements from certain NEOScavenger plots.
- Less tedious sleep/super-fast skip mechanic
- Refined auto-task coding (No, I don't want you to stand there with an empty power drill, PUT your fully charged back-up battery in it!)

items.text:
The game's engine creaks beneath its own weight, but the concept is compelling - space is big and uncaring, you are small and prone to dying due to hypoxia, and the game will do its best to simulate everything surrounding the two meeting. Salvage has its excitement and shipbuilding's results are undeniably satisfying, even if the process is agonizingly clunky. Given the game's promise I had been quite content to patiently watch it slowly develop as the years rolled by. Some day the AI would no longer be a narcoleptic mess, the UI would no longer be the biggest adversary, and the game would, y'know, [i]work[/i]. No more crashes or grinding lag from one of a dozen different things breaking in the background.

Then I got the announcement that the game had hit 1.0 and full release! 🚀 Waow, exciting!

I [i]broke into laughter[/i] at the absurdity of it. I have no idea what must have possessed Blue Bottle to release if not desperation, but if so they're certainly not copping to it. From the patchnotes released today: "[b]While we figured there would be [i]some[/i] pain points revealed with launch, I think we significantly underestimated just how many there were.[/b]" Given I knew that full-well as a simple player, I cannot fathom how the game's developers could be surprised. Rather, it reads to me as 'sorry you're so mad,' and the gall of it is part of what motivated me to write up this review in the first place.

The game's release as what purports to be a full 1.0 product is disingenuous at best, and gives me great pause with respect to the odds of the continued support of the game and its prospect of ever [i]actually[/i] being finished, rather than remaining a janky mess. I'm still content to wait the years I think it will take to get it there, but I'm no longer confident that will come to pass. New players should know what to expect when buying in, and it is definitively [i]not[/i] a finished, polished experience.
items.text_zh:
这游戏的引擎在自己重压下吱嘎作响，但概念很吸引人——太空浩瀚而冷漠，你渺小且容易因缺氧而死，游戏会尽力模拟两者相遇时周围的一切。打捞有其刺激感，造船的成果无可否认地令人满足，即便过程笨拙得令人痛苦。鉴于游戏的承诺，多年来我一直很满足于耐心地看着它慢慢开发。总有一天，AI 不会再是一团嗜睡症般的烂摊子，UI 不会再是最大的对手，游戏会，你懂的，[i]正常运作[/i]。不再有崩溃，也不再有后台十几个东西中某一个坏掉导致的卡顿延迟。

然后我看到了游戏达到 1.0 正式发布的公告！🚀 哇，真令人兴奋！

我[i]笑出了声[/i]，因为这事太荒谬了。我不知道是什么驱使 Blue Bottle 发布，如果不是绝望的话，但如果是的话，他们肯定不会承认。从今天发布的补丁说明来看：“[b]虽然我们料到发布时会暴露出[i]一些[/i]痛点，但我认为我们严重低估了痛点的数量。[/b]”既然我作为一个普通玩家都对此心知肚明，我无法理解游戏开发者怎么会感到惊讶。相反，在我看来这读起来像是‘抱歉你这么生气’，而其中的厚颜无耻正是促使我写下这篇评测的部分原因。

游戏以号称完整 1.0 产品的形式发布，往好了说是虚伪，往坏了说让我对游戏持续支持的可能性以及它是否[i]真正[/i]能完成、而不是继续一团糟的前景深感疑虑。我仍然愿意等待我认为需要数年才能达到那一步，但我不再确信那会实现。新玩家在购买时应该知道会面临什么，而这绝对[i]不是[/i]一次完成、打磨过的体验。

items.text:
I just can't recommend getting it as is i am afraid. 

- The character creation sucks and is lacking features like presets and preset saving, which is not that major anyways, since there is one player model and no matter what it won't look anything like your character regardless of what you chose. It's not just a visual element, i just also dislike the element of randomness in a character creation.

- The UI is awful. In fact, i think this has got to be bar none the worst UI i've ever had to deal with in a video game and i've known the dos era. The information is disorganized, badly presented, implies insane amounts of clicking, the (too) many UI elements have little graphic/logical coherency, it's just a terrible, terrible time dealing with it all. Sure you *can* get used to it. But it was just bad design that stuck throughout EA when it should have been scrapped and redone. No UI/UX person on board and it really shows sadly. Whether it be inventory, character information, terrain or anything else, you'll be trying to enjoy yourself in spite of it the whole time. 

- The game's whole premise is to foster a "theatre of the mind" (dev's words, not mine), but the entire NPC interaction system is just terrible. It's essentially the sims type of interactions, with no logic or coherency in interactions. It all boils down just standing like a chimp in front of NPCs you wish to engage with and spamming dialogue options until you get high enough relations that they decide to acknowledge your existence and give you what you expect from them. At no point this system even attempts to make sense and you find yourself chaining nonsensical interactions. It is *so bad*.

- The graphical fidelity still gets in the way of readability on many objects and terrain. Beyond the aesthetic choice, it's just so low fidelity that one struggles to just make sense of what's on screen most of the time, and while in many games this sort of aesthetic can look pleasing when done right, this just looks unreadable, visually busy and unappealing.

- The performance, which was a big problem when i first picked the game up during EA, has been improved, although i'm still experiencing memory leaks and major slowdowns with very little on the screen = Automatic negative review. Those leaks were identified over a year ago, there was ample time to fix them.

- Feature wise it's rather rich in my opinion but content wise it's still rather devoid of content and sadly my understanding is that the dev simply had to push it out the door for lack of funds. In this game you'll find very little story-driven elements and hand-crafted narratives. What's there is good, but it's insufficient. For a sandbox game like this one, it feels very empty.

- The soundscape is still very bland, which for a game purporting to immerse you, is a big let-down.

- The game pushes you to hire a crew but the whole crew management/interaction gameplay (and especially performance, yikes) feels very janky. 

- Outside of the few handcrafted quests, the rest is typical sandbox busy work nonsense fluff and fetch-quests. Yawn.

- Jobs (non handcrafted quests) tend to be buggy and break, leading players to decide to just skip this entire area and to focus on other revenue streams.

So what's there to enjoy then?

- The ship piloting feels excellent.
- The scavenging, albeit repetitive as sin over time, is interesting.
- Ship building is interesting to engage with and has plenty of features to deal with.
- Exploring, although limited because again, world feels bland, empty and unfinished.
- There's some measure of hope for this game as it features a steam workshop integration.
- Murder investigations, if they weren't still as buggy, would be enjoyable as well.

My hope for the game is that the dev keeps working on it to finish what was clearly not yet cooked and ready to come out of the oven. On top of that, i hope for modders to address the main issues of this game, first and foremost the unforgivably bad NPC interaction system, and if at all possible, the UI.

As it stands though, do yourself a favor and do not engage until significant work is done on this title. It's a big let down for me and i'm sorry about it because i have a lot of respect for the Dev as a person, but this soured me on supporting their future endeavors a great deal.
items.text_zh:
恐怕我只能说，就目前这个样子，我实在没法推荐购买。

- 角色创建很糟糕，缺少预设和预设保存之类的功能，不过反正这也没那么重要，因为只有一个玩家模型，不管你选了什么，它看起来都完全不像你的角色。这不仅仅是个视觉元素的问题，我也很讨厌角色创建里的随机性元素。

- UI 糟透了。事实上，我觉得这绝对是我在电子游戏里遇到过的最烂的 UI，我可是经历过 DOS 时代的人。信息杂乱无章，呈现得很差，意味着要疯狂点击，那些（过多的）UI 元素在图形/逻辑上几乎没有连贯性，处理这一切简直就是一段糟糕透顶、糟糕透顶的体验。当然，你*可以*习惯它。但这本身就是糟糕的设计，在整个 EA 阶段一直存在，本该被废弃重做。团队里没有 UI/UX 方面的人，这一点很遗憾地暴露无遗。无论是物品栏、角色信息、地形还是别的什么，你全程都得在忍受它的同时努力让自己玩得开心。

- 这游戏的整个前提是营造一种“心灵剧场”（这是开发者的话，不是我说的），但整个 NPC 交互系统就是糟糕透顶。它本质上是《模拟人生》那种交互，交互中毫无逻辑或连贯性。一切都归结为像只黑猩猩一样站在你想互动的 NPC 面前，狂刷对话选项，直到关系值够高，他们才决定承认你的存在，给你你期望从他们那里得到的东西。这个系统在任何时候都甚至没有尝试过要讲得通，你会发现自己在一连串毫无意义的交互中循环。它*太糟了*。

- 图形保真度仍然妨碍着许多物体和地形的可读性。抛开审美选择不谈，它的保真度就是太低了，大多数时候人都很难看懂屏幕上是什么，虽然在很多游戏里这种审美如果做得好会看起来令人愉悦，但这个看起来就是难以辨认、视觉上杂乱且毫无吸引力。

- 性能问题，在我最初于 EA 阶段入手这游戏时是个大问题，现在已经有所改善，不过我仍然会遇到内存泄漏和严重的卡顿，而屏幕上几乎没什么东西 = 自动差评。那些泄漏一年多以前就被发现了，有充足的时间去修复。

- 就功能而言，在我看来相当丰富，但就内容而言，它仍然相当缺乏内容，而且遗憾的是，据我所知，开发者只是因为缺钱不得不把它赶着推出门。在这个游戏里，你会发现极少有剧情驱动的元素和手工打造的叙事。现有的内容是不错，但不够。对于像这样的沙盒游戏来说，它感觉非常空洞。

- 音景仍然非常平淡，对于一个号称要让你沉浸其中的游戏来说，这是很大的失望。

- 游戏推动你去雇佣一支船员，但整个船员管理/交互的玩法（尤其是性能，哎呀）感觉非常蹩脚。

- 除了少数几个手工打造的任务之外，其余都是典型的沙盒式忙碌工作、无意义的填充内容和跑腿任务。呵欠。

- 工作（非手工打造的任务）往往有 bug 并且会出故障，导致玩家决定干脆跳过这整个区域，转而专注于其他收入来源。

那么还有什么可享受的呢？

- 飞船驾驶手感极佳。
- 拾荒，尽管时间久了重复得要命，但挺有意思。
- 飞船建造玩起来很有意思，而且有大量功能可以折腾。
- 探索，尽管受限，因为还是那句话，世界感觉平淡、空洞且未完成。
- 这游戏还有一定希望，因为它集成了 Steam 创意工坊。
- 谋杀案调查，如果它们不是仍然那么多 bug 的话，也会挺有趣的。

我对这游戏的希望是开发者继续努力，把那些显然还没煮熟、还没准备好出炉的东西做完。除此之外，我希望模组作者能解决这游戏的主要问题，首当其冲的就是那不可原谅的糟糕 NPC 交互系统，如果可能的话，还有 UI。

不过就目前而言，行行好，在这个作品有重大改进之前别去碰它。这让我非常失望，我也为此感到遗憾，因为我个人非常尊重这位开发者，但这件事让我在支持他们未来事业方面大打了折扣。

- 谋杀调查，如果它们不那么漏洞百出的话，也会很有趣。

我对这款游戏的希望是开发者继续努力，完成那些显然还没煮熟、还没准备好出炉的部分。除此之外，我希望模组制作者能解决这款游戏的主要问题，首先是那不可原谅的糟糕NPC互动系统，如果可能的话，还有UI。

СЛИШКОМ РАНО ДЛЯ 1.0
Уже несколько лет эта игра находится в долгой и затягивающейся разработке. По началу, эта игра настолько мне понравилась, что она вдохновила меня на творчество по hard sci-fi сеттингу. Но что же могло пойти не так?.... 

Нет, у меня ощущение что разработчик устал делать эту игру. Бесконечное количество багов, отвратительный интерфейс и, о боже, полностью пустые NPC в игре с упором на ролевую игру. 
Разбирать бесконечно обломки и сражаться с пиратами может и затягивает первое время, но игра как была про гринд с багами, так и осталась. 
Разработчик убил ожидания. Будучи в релизе 1.0, игра находится в состоянии глубокой беты которую нужно еще ОЧЕНЬ долго доделывать. 
Вы можете попробовать эту игру, в ней есть шарм и вайб, однако она, бялть, ни разу не готова к релизу, будьте готовы к бесконечным багам, пустым механникам, отсутвию локализации (единственный русификатор на игру ломает ее еще больше, при том что переведено лишь ~25% текста) и долгому гринду.

On my last run before 1.0 I strapped a fusion engine and four cargo pods to my modified shipping container starter and set course to Venus. I passed out from G forces during the initial burn because I set the autopilot acceleration limit too high and woke up six hours later coasting. My ship was small so I would uninstall the bed and move it out of the airlock to make room for the toilet and exercise equipment between naps. 

On approach, I couldn't decelerate fast enough because of g-force limits and nearly slammed into the destination station at 200km/s. Re-approaching took almost every bit of fuel I had left - I think i had under 150m/s of dV left when I docked. 

There are bugs and some imperfect things and the UI is complicated and messy (and atmospheric), but I've had a ton of fun with this game and I couldn't recommend it enough.

It's unfortunately just not that fun for the amount of effort you have to put in, and plagued with bugs and performance issues. It's been a delight jumping in every now and then to see what has changed (I purchased this the day it was available in EA, having had ridiculous amounts of fun with Neo Scavenger - and I don't consider the money "wasted"), and it's not flawed because of a lack of passion or drive. It's just one of those titles where the stated vision never quite truly eventuated in a way that lived up to it for me, which is a shame.

I'm not adverse to complexity! I've spent hundreds, thousands of hours in Paradox titles and games like Terra Invicta. The core game loop is - in theory - something I'd enjoy, but the interface and implementation just kills it for me, and the move to 1.0 means I've got to judge this "as is" and I can't say I'd recommend it. Your milage may vary.

items.text:
Games like Ostranauts make me hate Early Access.

I was really excited about this game when it came out. A hobo simulator from the creator of NEO Scavenger, only now in space? Being able to create, modify and dismantle ships in an open world sandbox where other space hobos went about their day, blazing your path through the galaxy, all in a systems-intensive, survival sim where taking care of your ship is as important as taking care of yourself?! Sign me the hell up! Okay, sure, it's in a bit of a rough shape right now, but it just came out on Early Access, I'm sure with time things will improve.

And one year passed by. Two. Three. Six years Ostranauts has permanently been installed in my computer, always taking a peek after a major update, and always bouncing off hard due to very frustrating, elemental jank that would force enormous rollbacks to my save. Confusing UI; brain-dead AI getting into looping, nonsensical conversations; unintuitive objectives relying on poorly explained unique interactions. Over the span of months the developers would keep futzing around, fleshing out one ancillary feature while introducing 5 more bugs and while the rest of the core loop would remain a raging dumpster fire: AI ships colliding because they couldn't figure out the way to dock, NPCs acting completely randomly, entire stations decompressing, broken pathing... game breaking ♥♥♥♥ would keep getting pushed to the main version, and slowly but surely, reality started to set in: the game wasn't going to grow, we'd be lucky if the developers ended up making it playable.

Ostranauts has barely developed through Early Access. It entered as barely an alpha, and it's leaving barely a beta. The only thing Blue Bottle Games has managed to do in this time is add fluff like missions full of scripting errors and vague, blink-and-you'll-miss objectives that you will never again be able to track once that dialog box closes, and even if we ignore the still very real colossal ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ that can absolutely brick your game unless you roll back 30 minutes worth of progression, the core game loop is just not fun, because it's barely developed from the almost placeholder gameplay from 2020. Every single feature feels as ugly, unintuitive and ungainly as the gameplay itself.

The game still feels like there's a ton of progression that either was never intended to be there, or that the developers gave up on. The difference between "space hobo" and "actually pretty well off" is minimal, as itemization usually boils down to "you have nothing" or "you have the best tool in the game because there's only one". Maybe you'll get a second, middle option if you're lucky (as in, you may have no screwdriver, a normal screwdriver or an *electric* screwdriver). You can still collect all kinds of trash and put them in containers, boxes and bins, but since there's no crafting, you don't really have a reason to do so and it becomes incredibly tedious to browse through which bin has the bag that has the jacket that has your food. What worked in NEO scavenger to make you feel resourceful and crafty becomes bloated and purposeless in Ostranauts.

The mechanical tinkering and systems management which was once one of the most exciting prospects when the game came out is for the most part reduced to a few increasingly flashy flavors of "on or off". There's no logic, no programming, no deeper interactions than "connect air pump to air sensor". Expanding your ship feels unsatisfying and clunky, mostly due to the godawful UI. Okay, let me put an example:

Let's say you want to move 5 units of cable. You can't queue up orders, instead, what you want to do is:

- Click your PDA
- Click on "orders"
- Click on "uninstall"
- Unselect all the options except "conduit" (otherwise you're going to uninstall the floor)
- Drag a square through those 5 units
- Set your character on "autotask"
- Wait for them to uninstall the 5 units of cable
- Pick up the cable (otherwise your character is going to pick each piece individually)
- Select "install" (not "orders" you silly goose!)
- Scroll down a list of every single item in the game (yes, that includes every single variant of floor and wall, regardless of whether it's in your inventory or vicinity) until you find the exact thing you want to install.
- Set down the work order for each item you want to install
- Set your character on "autotask"
- Wait for them to do the job.

The alternative is to right click on each piece of cable, select "uninstall", and wait for the character to uninstall the bit of cable before being able to right click on the next one, being very careful that each of those right clicks actually selects the cable, otherwise you might uninstall the floor and completely vent your ship to space. Oops! Hope you saved not too long ago!

Taking care of your character is similarly a thankless, overwrought chore, with a billion little interactions that will keep slightly tweaking up or down a million sub-needs like "intimacy" or "self worth", none of which ever really amount to anything. You will never make meaningful connections with NPCs because interactions amount to little more than Sims-like random topic exchanges lacking even a tiny bit of flavor text to make conversations feel real; and with quests being sterile, incredibly basic "this guy asks you to find this other guy and talk to him" affairs that require chasing down NPCs that will keep spazzing all over the place while trying to talk to them, Ostranauts fails feel alive or immersive. It fails to be a survival game, a sandbox game, an RPG, a builder, or a narrative adventure. It fails at everything. It is astonishingly bad, moreso when considering that its predecessor, NEO Scavenger, did actually a really good job when it came to progression, survival, and questing. It's just a loose collection of rough mechanics that never feel fun by themselves and never play into each other, controlled by a redundant, clunky, annoying UI that calling "undercooked" would be a kindness to.

For years I've kept hoping Ostranauts would actually develop in the direction it aimed for when it released, and yet it's going to "release" in what could barely be qualified as acceptable by the standards it itself set six years ago. It is a hollowed husk of potential ruined by a developer that has just been faffing around solving problems of their own creation instead of actually developing the game. It is a colossal disappointment, and a game that I'm truly sad to advise against.

Play NEO Scavenger instead. It's a bit of a rough gem with a lot of questionable design choices that really really likes to screw the player over, but it just does everything Ostranauts tries to do but better. If you want a mechanically deep, complex survival game, then play Stationeers instead. Want something snappier and less involved? Hardspace Shipbreaker. If you want a procedural, detailed world with hints of survival, Qud or Dwarf Fortress are good options.

Do not buy this game. Even if worked like it should (which it doesn't), and even if it was fun (which it isn't), it's just an incredibly shallow, unsatisfying, frustrating mess of a game. 3/10.

像《Ostranauts》这样的游戏让我痛恨抢先体验。

这款游戏刚出来的时候我真的很兴奋。一个由《NEO Scavenger》创作者打造的流浪汉模拟器，只不过这次是在太空里？能够在一个开放世界沙盒中创建、改装和拆解飞船，其他太空流浪汉也各自过着自己的日子，你在银河系中开辟自己的道路，这一切都发生在一个系统密集的生存模拟中，照顾你的飞船和照顾你自己一样重要？！算我一个！好吧，当然，它现在状态有点粗糙，但它才刚进入抢先体验，我相信随着时间推移情况会改善的。

然后一年过去了。两年。三年。六年了，《Ostranauts》一直永久安装在我的电脑里，每次大更新后我都会瞄一眼，然后总是被极其令人沮丧的、根本性的毛病狠狠劝退，这些毛病会迫使我大幅回滚存档。令人困惑的UI；脑死亡的AI陷入循环的、毫无意义的对话；依赖解释不清的独特交互的不直观目标。在数月的时间里，开发者们一直在瞎折腾，充实一个附属功能的同时引入5个新bug，而核心循环的其余部分仍然是一团熊熊燃烧的垃圾箱大火：AI飞船因为搞不清对接方式而相撞，NPC行为完全随机，整个空间站失压，寻路损坏……破坏游戏的♥♥♥♥不断被推送到主版本，慢慢地但确凿地，现实开始显现：这游戏不会成长了，如果开发者最终能让它变得可玩，我们就该谢天谢地了。

《Ostranauts》在抢先体验期间几乎没有发展。它进入时勉强算个alpha，离开时勉强算个beta。Blue Bottle Games在这段时间里唯一做到的就是添加一些填充内容，比如充满脚本错误的任务，以及模糊的、眨眼就会错过的目标，一旦那个对话框关闭你就再也无法追踪它们，而且即使我们忽略那些仍然非常真实的、巨大的♥♥♥♥♥♥♥——除非你回滚30分钟的进度，否则它绝对能让你的游戏彻底报废——核心游戏循环就是不好玩，因为它从2020年几乎占位符式的玩法以来几乎没有发展。每一个功能都像玩法本身一样丑陋、不直观、笨拙。

这游戏仍然感觉有大量进程要么从来就没打算存在，要么开发者已经放弃了。"太空流浪汉"和"其实过得挺不错"之间的差别微乎其微，因为物品化通常归结为"你什么都没有"或者"你拥有游戏里最好的工具，因为只有这一个"。如果你运气好，也许会有第二个中间选项（也就是说，你可能没有螺丝刀、有一把普通螺丝刀，或者有一把*电动*螺丝刀）。你仍然可以收集各种垃圾并把它们放进容器、箱子和垃圾桶里，但既然没有制作系统，你其实没有理由这么做，而且翻找哪个垃圾桶里有那个装着那件夹克的包、而那件夹克里又有你的食物，会变得极其繁琐。在《NEO Scavenger》中让你感到足智多谋、心灵手巧的东西，在《Ostranauts》中变得臃肿且毫无目的。

机械修修补补和系统管理，曾经是游戏刚出来时最令人兴奋的前景之一，如今在很大程度上被简化为几种越来越花哨的"开或关"。没有逻辑，没有编程，没有比"把气泵连接到空气传感器"更深入的交互。扩展你的飞船感觉不令人满意且笨拙，主要是因为那糟糕透顶的UI。好吧，让我举个例子：

假设你想移动5单位电缆。你不能排队下达命令，相反，你要做的是：

- 点击你的PDA
- 点击"订单"
- 点击"卸载"
- 取消选择除"导管"以外的所有选项（否则你会把地板也卸载掉）
- 拖一个方框框住那5单位
- 把你的角色设置为"自动任务"
- 等他们卸载那5单位电缆
- 捡起电缆（否则你的角色会一根一根地捡）
- 选择"安装"（不是"订单"，你这个傻瓜！）
- 向下滚动游戏里每一个物品的列表（是的，包括地板和墙壁的每一种变体，不管它是在你的库存里还是在附近）直到找到你想安装的那个确切东西。
- 为你想要安装的每个物品设置工作订单
- 把你的角色设置为"自动任务"
- 等他们完成工作。

另一种选择是右键点击每一段电缆，选择"卸载"，等角色卸载完那段电缆后才能右键点击下一段，同时要非常小心每一次右键点击确实选中了电缆，否则你可能会卸载地板，让你的飞船完全向太空泄压。哎呀！希望你不久前刚存过档！

照顾你的角色同样是一件吃力不讨好的、过度繁重的苦差事，有无数琐碎的交互会不断微调上百万个子需求，比如"亲密感"或"自我价值"，而这些需求从来都不会真正带来任何结果。你永远不会和NPC建立有意义的联系，因为交互不过是类似《模拟人生》的随机话题交换，连一丁点让对话显得真实的调味文本都没有；而任务则是干巴巴的、极其基本的"这个人让你去找另一个人并和他说话"之类的事，需要你追着那些在你想和他们说话时不停抽搐乱动的NPC跑，《Ostranauts》既无法让人感到鲜活，也无法让人沉浸。它作为生存游戏、沙盒游戏、RPG、建造游戏或叙事冒险都失败了。它什么都失败。它糟糕得令人震惊，尤其是考虑到它的前作《NEO Scavenger》在进程、生存和任务方面实际上做得非常好。它只是一堆松散拼凑的粗糙机制，本身从不让人觉得有趣，也从不相互配合，由一个冗余、笨拙、烦人的UI操控，说它"欠火候"都算是客气了。

多年来我一直希望《Ostranauts》能真正朝着它发布时所瞄准的方向发展，然而它即将以按照它自己六年前设定的标准都勉强算合格的状态"发布"。它是一个被掏空的潜力躯壳，被一个只是一直在瞎忙活、解决自己制造的问题而不是真正开发游戏的开发者毁掉了。这是一个巨大的失望，也是一款我真的很遗憾要劝人别买的游戏。

去玩《NEO Scavenger》吧。它是一颗有点粗糙的宝石，有很多可疑的设计选择，非常非常喜欢坑玩家，但它就是把《Ostranauts》试图做的一切都做得更好。如果你想要一个机制深刻、复杂的生存游戏，那就去玩《Stationeers》。想要更爽快、更轻松的？《Hardspace Shipbreaker》。如果你想要一个程序生成的、细节丰富的、带点生存元素的世界，《Qud》或《Dwarf Fortress》都是不错的选择。

不要买这个游戏。即使它像应该的那样运作（但它并没有），即使它好玩（但它并不好玩），它也只是一款极其肤浅、令人不满、令人沮丧的烂游戏。3/10。

items.text:
Recommended

It does have its flaws iv noticed like annoying bugs and glitches but opening command console/cheat menu and click of a button fix's them.

Ostranauts is one of the most immersive and unforgiving space survival sims I've played. Instead of making you feel like a heroic captain saving the galaxy, it drops you into the role of an ordinary person trying to survive in space before the age of populated Mars

The ship building and salvage mechanics are good. Every component feels has it's importance, whether you're rerouting power, repairing life support, or stripping for parts. The level of simulation is impressive without becoming completely inaccessible, and solving problems aboard your ship feels rewarding.

What really sets Ostranauts apart is the atmosphere. The stations feel grimy and lived-in, NPCs have their own lives and motivations, though they do like to die a lot from the stations glitching out after you remove doors for being a wanted criminal. Now fires are a thing it makes that part a lot more entertaining and interesting...
also equipment fails, oxygen runs low, or an unexpected emergency forces you to improvise.

The game is still in development, and there are rough edges. The interface is good, Tricky at first. However the developers are actively improving the game, and the depth already on display is remarkable.

If you enjoy complex simulations, emergent storytelling,  and the idea of being a every day person and i say that lightly like a (spacefaring scavenger) rather  Ostranauts is absolutely worth your time.
items.text_zh:
推荐

它确实有我已经注意到的缺陷，比如烦人的bug和故障，但打开命令控制台/作弊菜单并点击一个按钮就能修复它们。

《Ostranauts》是我玩过的最具沉浸感、最无情的太空生存模拟游戏之一。它不会让你感觉自己是一位拯救银河系的英雄船长，而是把你扔进一个普通人的角色，在火星尚未有人居住的时代努力在太空中生存。

飞船建造和打捞机制很好。每个部件都有其重要性，无论你是在重新分配电力、修理生命维持系统，还是拆解零件。模拟的深度令人印象深刻，却又不会变得完全难以理解，而且在飞船上解决问题让人感到有回报。

真正让《Ostranauts》与众不同的是它的氛围。空间站感觉肮脏而有人居住的痕迹，NPC有自己的生活和动机，不过他们确实很容易死，因为在你作为通缉犯拆掉门之后空间站会出故障。现在火灾也成了游戏的一部分，这让那部分变得更加有趣和好玩……
此外设备会故障，氧气会耗尽，或者一场意外的紧急情况迫使你随机应变。

游戏仍在开发中，还有一些粗糙的边缘。界面不错，一开始有点棘手。然而开发者正在积极改进游戏，而且已经展现出的深度非常了不起。

如果你喜欢复杂的模拟、涌现式叙事，以及做一个普通人——我这话说得轻描淡写，就像一个（太空打捞者）——那么《Ostranauts》绝对值得你花时间。

items.text:
I can't recommend this game, especially if you're a software engineer.

At first glance this game looks awesome: space, systems, ship building. But after some time you will see this game internally is an engineering disaster.

- The first thing that will "please" you is a loading screen that never ends. You wait... wait... and then realize it's not a loading screen -- you must click. Yes, the game didn't bother to tell you.
- Everything is JSON. Save files are 300MB of human-readable garbage. And when you mention it, someone will say: "You don't understand, they are compressed!" Right. Compression definitely fixes fundamental architectural flaws.
- Looking at old roadmaps, you'll notice most versions are just "overhaul of already overhauled system". Author not adding content, he's just rewriting what game already had. Again. And again.
- Last version introduced JSON vs JSON combat. The result is a bit predictable.
- The game runs poorly even on modern hardware. It slowly consumes memory until it eats all 32GB and starts stuttering. This is not "early access issues". This is a memory leak.
- You will start the game and first station will already run slow, because there are simulated JSONs flying in space nearby.
- Steam Cloud added, not just to make your computer cry, but your Steam too, when it will upload all this disaster to cloud every time.

The whole game is just a bunch of different, not well-designed/-implemented/-fitted systems:
- "spaceship combat" exists, but you have to fly to a specific location to use it.
- "atmospheric flight" is another isolated minigame.
- RPG-like traits exist but barely useful.
- social system is no more than just absurd.
- most stations are empty placeholders.
- main story is a placeholder.

The game works as a tech demo that shows how bad engineering decisions can ruin a great idea. I'm sure the author will apply some minor patches, call it 1.0 and forget this nightmare.

Graphics/UI/UX
Graphics is ugly. Ugly faces, ugly items, ugly pixel-"art", already many-times-overhauled HUD is... looks bad. Good luck to find items under conduits. Context-menu-based interaction will wear and tear you more than your ship.
The already-overhauled tutorial annoys you with popups and walls of text instead of teaching. It's not helpful, it's just frustrating.

Music
Only thing that leaves positive vibes is music. The music is awesome. Huge respects to the composer.

And of course, author didn't forget to shove they/them pronouns into character creation, but to be fair I'm pretty sure it was publisher's idea, because the game certainly didn't need more controversy.
items.text_zh:
我不能推荐这款游戏，尤其是如果你是一名软件工程师。

乍一看，这款游戏看起来很酷：太空、系统、飞船建造。但过一段时间你就会发现，这款游戏内部是一场工程灾难。

- 第一件会“取悦”你的事，是一个永远不结束的加载界面。你等啊……等啊……然后才意识到这不是加载界面——你必须点击。是的，游戏懒得告诉你。
- 一切都是JSON。存档文件是300MB的人类可读垃圾。而当你提到这一点时，有人会说：“你不懂，它们是压缩过的！”对。压缩肯定能修复根本性的架构缺陷。
- 看看旧路线图，你会注意到大多数版本都只是“对已经重做过的系统再次重做”。作者没有添加内容，他只是重写游戏已经有的东西。又一次。又一次。
- 上一个版本引入了JSON对JSON战斗。结果有点可预测。
- 这款游戏即使在现代硬件上也运行得很差。它会慢慢消耗内存，直到吃掉全部32GB并开始卡顿。这不是“抢先体验问题”。这是内存泄漏。
- 你会启动游戏，而第一个空间站就已经运行缓慢，因为附近太空中有模拟的JSON在飞来飞去。
- 添加了Steam云，不只是让你的电脑哭，也让你的Steam哭，因为它每次都会把这一团灾难上传到云端。

整个游戏只是一堆不同的、设计/实现/整合都不佳的系统：
- “飞船战斗”存在，但你必须飞到特定地点才能使用它。
- “大气飞行”是另一个孤立的小游戏。
- 类似RPG的特质存在，但几乎没什么用。
- 社交系统不过是荒谬而已。
- 大多数空间站都是空占位符。
- 主线剧情是一个占位符。

这款游戏就像一个技术演示，展示糟糕的工程决策如何毁掉一个伟大的想法。我确信作者会打一些小的补丁，称其为1.0，然后忘掉这场噩梦。

图形/UI/UX
图形很丑。丑陋的脸、丑陋的物品、丑陋的像素“艺术”，已经重做过很多次的HUD是……看起来很差。祝你在管道下面找到物品。基于上下文菜单的交互会比你的飞船更磨损你。
已经重做过的教程用弹窗和大段文字烦你，而不是教学。它没有帮助，只会让人沮丧。

音乐
唯一留下正面感受的东西是音乐。音乐很棒。向作曲家致以巨大敬意。

当然，作者没有忘记把they/them代词塞进角色创建里，但公平地说，我很确定这是发行商的主意，因为这款游戏肯定不需要更多争议。

items.text:
I feel like the game is finally in a very good place. I never put too many hours into it in the past due to performance issues, clunky menus, and mechanics that were not explained well, if at all.

All of that seems to be mostly fixed now, and I’m able to grasp and make sense of the systems, goals, and mechanics without scouring through a wiki or watching multiple tutorial videos. I was scavving, building, and designing additions to my ship like a pro within a couple of hours.

As a caveat, I must say that I can't properly vouch for performance on lower-end systems, as I have a fairly high-end CPU. If you do end up trying the game on lower-end hardware, try to avoid fast-forwarding too much in active places like stations, I’ve seen some people with weaker systems run into hiccups or freezing when doing this, which is understandable considering how much the game has to simulate in these areas (atmos, NPC needs, routines, etc.).

I’m finally truly enjoying my time with the game, what used to feel like unrealized potential has finally been realized.

I would definitely recommend the game if you enjoyed NEO Scavenger and/or want a hard sci-fi space frontier game with deeply simulated systems, or if you just want to live out your dreams of being a space hobo flying around in a ship you cobbled together yourself, one that more closely resembles a trashcan than a functional vessel.

我终于真正享受这款游戏了，过去那种未实现潜力的感觉，如今终于变成了现实。

如果你喜欢《NEO Scavenger》和/或想要一款拥有深度模拟系统的硬科幻太空边疆游戏，或者如果你只是想实现自己的梦想——当一个太空流浪汉，开着一艘自己拼凑起来的飞船四处飞，而那艘船看起来更像垃圾桶而不是一艘能用的飞船，那我绝对会推荐这款游戏。

items.text:
Media embodiment of autism. Clocked close to 50 hours within the first few days of playing this. Yet I've decided to put it down until it becomes more polished.

There is just this feeling with this game that the developers are so driven to create a complex system that they aren't focused to slow down and refine the individual core processes that are the pieces that bring that system alive.

They're soon to add ship-combat but how long can they keep putting systems together before it eventually just becomes too much? I would really suggest the developers to slow down a little and simply work out how to make the game more playable (the keyword being playable, not fun, nor complex - both it is - but playable).

A few core systems are lacking depth that pull you out of the game given how immersive it can be at times:
- mental status/social/relationships seem to have no real significant impact on gameplay; I rolled a smoker character. To light a cigarette you have to a) have cigarettes in the pack itself) b) action the pack of cigarettes to light a cigarette) c) put out the cigarette but dragging it from your mouth to the trash or on the floor - turns out if you're suffering a nicotine withdrawl it does little to actually affect your gameplay meaning you can simply select smoker for a free point and never smoke. 
- The UI is incredibly clunky and difficult to navigate; Why can't I pin my inventory to always be displayed? The game becomes a slog after you start to manage your needs alongside your crew and ship. Why can't I customise the UI features? I don't half my screen obscured by an event log when half the event log is fluff in itself. 
- variety of items (excluding ship items)

I don't know if this is a bug or not but I left items outside of the ship during a derelict run and when I docked at the station all the items were still where I left them but had somehow traveled half way across the star system without being in a cargoweb? I spent 15 minutes putting together a cargo web system on the backend to ensure I can carry more items to find out I can just game it by not doing so (which I refuse to do so but it just pulls you out when you know you can. It also turns out you can just use floor tiles to do so as well... Why bother with a cargo web item if you can just a) game the system, b) rip a floor off a ship your salvaging and always have storage - this gets to a point where you start to not worry about what you can take and can't take as you know you can just rip stuff apart and throw it on the back of your ship without any care or worry...

Further example... Docked my ship but forgot to turn off my proximity alarm. Time to now close down my menu, walk all the way back to my ship, right click the NAV centre - slot them in. Click the alarm. Make them get out of the seat. Walk all the way back. The feature of the proximity alarm is crucial to space travel - why can't there be a little toggle next to it in-it-self to toggle on and off upon docking? You can link your NAV console to your PDA - why can't I simply toggle it from my PDA? Or simply add a new PDA chip that allows you to do so? These little touches that would make it less of a chore.

I think this will hands down be the best simulator on the market once the time comes - but it's a matter of when, not if. 

I still highly recommend it - the above is simply feedback for the developers.
items.text_zh:
自闭症在媒体中的化身。在开始玩这款游戏的几天内，游戏时间就接近50小时。然而我决定先放下它，直到它变得更加完善。

这款游戏给人一种感觉：开发者如此执着于创建一个复杂的系统，以至于他们没有专注于放慢脚步，去打磨那些让整个系统活起来的各个核心流程。

他们很快就要加入飞船战斗，但在最终变得太多之前，他们还能把系统拼凑多久？我真的建议开发者放慢一点，简单地想办法让游戏更可玩（关键词是可玩，不是有趣，也不是复杂——这两者它都具备——而是可玩）。

有几个核心系统缺乏深度，考虑到游戏有时能如此沉浸，这会把你从游戏中拉出来：
- 精神状态/社交/关系似乎对玩法没有真正显著的影响；我随机了一个吸烟者角色。要点燃一支烟，你必须 a) 烟盒里本身有烟 b) 对烟盒执行动作来点燃一支烟 c) 熄灭香烟，但要把烟从嘴里拖到垃圾桶或地板上——结果发现，如果你正遭受尼古丁戒断，它实际上对玩法几乎没有影响，这意味着你可以直接选择吸烟者来白拿一个点数，然后永远不抽烟。
- UI极其笨重且难以操作；为什么我不能把物品栏固定为始终显示？当你开始同时管理自己的需求、船员和飞船时，游戏就变成了一件苦差事。为什么我不能自定义UI功能？我可不想半个屏幕被事件日志挡住，而事件日志本身有一半都是废话。
- 物品种类（不包括飞船物品）

我不知道这是不是bug，但我在一次废弃飞船探索中把物品留在了飞船外面，当我在空间站停靠时，所有物品都还在我留下的地方，却不知怎么在不在货网里的情况下穿越了半个星系？我花了15分钟在后端搭建了一个货网系统，以确保我能携带更多物品，结果发现我只要不这么做就能钻空子（我拒绝这么做，但当你知道自己可以这么做时，它就会把你从游戏中拉出来。结果还发现你只要用地板砖也能做到……如果你能 a) 钻系统空子，b) 从你正在打捞的飞船上拆下一块地板，然后永远都有存储空间，那还要货网物品干什么——这到了某个地步，你开始不再担心自己能拿什么、不能拿什么，因为你知道你可以随便把东西拆开，毫不在意、毫不担心地扔到飞船后面……

再举个例子……我把飞船停靠好了，但忘了关掉我的接近警报。现在得关掉我的菜单，一路走回我的飞船，右键点击导航中心——把它们放进去。点击警报。让它们从座位上起来。再一路走回去。接近警报这个功能对太空旅行至关重要——为什么不能在它旁边本身就有个小开关，在停靠时切换开和关？你可以把你的导航控制台连接到你的PDA——为什么我不能直接从我的PDA上切换它？或者干脆加一个新的PDA芯片让你能做到这一点？这些小小的细节会让它少很多麻烦。

我认为等到时机成熟，这毫无疑问会是市场上最好的模拟器——但问题是什么时候，而不是会不会。

我仍然强烈推荐它——以上只是给开发者的反馈。

It's just way too janky. It feels like the game kinda expects you to have an engineering degree, and the tutorial is dreadfully underdeveloped imo. The screen is clogged with HUD elements and it's a real bother to sort through the fog of useless information to the stuff that actually matters. 

EDIT: After giving it a go since my love for Neo Scavanger made me interested in this game to begin with (the dev is a very talented guy) i fin myself enjoying this work in progress more than i expected after the abysmal tutorial. I get that unfinished games don't have all of that, but it's also kinda frustrating to entrust new players to discord server or wiki instead of having fundemental game mechanics explained to you. And a map for navigating the layers of HUD and well everything. There are manuals, but it doesn't translate easy into practice.

I still cannot in recommend this to any new player, simply because the game has some performance issues, and that the game does a poor job of explaining basic mechanics of the game to the player. 

So what's neat about this game? Well for starters it has immersive first person interactive controls and HUD elements while the game is set in an isometric top-down perspective. I'm not sure if anyone has ever done that before. It's a sim that has many elements of space-faring realism built into it. You can start with a tiny box of a ship and make it huge, or haul stuff, or flip ships or all of the above. It is still very rough at this stage, but it certainly is immersive and makes you feel like a desperate person trying to earn enough to escape a dystopia which reminds one of classic sci-fi franchises.

编辑：既然我对Neo Scavanger的热爱一开始就让我对这款游戏产生了兴趣（开发者是个非常有才华的人），在试玩之后，我发现自己尽管经历了糟糕透顶的教程，却比预期更享受这个尚在开发中的作品。我明白未完成的游戏不会具备所有那些东西，但把新玩家托付给Discord服务器或wiki，而不是向你解释基本的游戏机制，这也挺令人沮丧的。还有一张用于在层层HUD以及一切之中导航的地图。有手册，但不容易转化为实践。

我仍然无法向任何新玩家推荐这款游戏，仅仅是因为游戏存在一些性能问题，而且游戏在向玩家解释基本机制方面做得很差。

那么这款游戏有什么妙处呢？首先，它拥有沉浸式的第一人称交互控制和HUD元素，而游戏本身却设定在等距俯视视角下。我不确定以前是否有人这样做过。这是一款模拟游戏，内置了许多太空航行的写实元素。你可以从一艘小盒子般的飞船起步，把它变得巨大，或者运输货物，或者翻转飞船，或者以上全都做。在这个阶段它仍然非常粗糙，但它确实很有沉浸感，让你感觉自己是个绝望的人，努力赚够钱逃离一个反乌托邦，这让人想起经典的科幻系列。

Really enjoying this salvage and space sim. Hoping to make it to Venus with my current playthrough, which is only around 30-40 hours so far. Hopefully I can make it before the "Fire in the Hole" Update haha (which is adding fire mechanics and ship combat)

If you like Cassette Futurism like Aliens with dystopian elements/themes, with a nice helping of the Expanse and Firefly into this space sim RPG. If you don't mind the salvaging, ship-breaking and ship-building with mostly realistic mechanics, space travel and life simulations (needing to eat and sleep) to dealing with corpos and pirates to get yourself out of debt and into bigger/better ships and/or building your own. I would say you should definitely check this one out and see if you enjoy it.

The only thing I will say however is that the UI and Inventory management is a bit rough/cluttered. I hope the devs look at the mods and suggestions to streamline the inventory UI/Management before the 1.0 Release! (Recommend a mod called UniPocket and Consolidated Backpacks to reduce the clutter)

I haven't gotten far enough myself yet to talk more about the Crew Management, but you will need a fairly bigger ship, steady income, and it takes a while until you've gotten a handle on things and started reselling derelicts that you've fixed up from salvage.

items.text:
A flawed gem that kept pulling me back - but after 4 years, hope is gone. 

Ostranauts is a complex, deeply atmospheric game. I love the sci-fi setting — it feels alive and grounded. The systems are intricate, interwoven, and demand full attention. The tension and immersion it creates are unmatched.

I also really like the panels and cockpit elements — flipping switches, managing ship systems, and navigating the old-school interfaces is incredibly satisfying.

But... it’s also ugly as hell. The UI is clunky and unintuitive. Cargo management becomes a punishing Tetris-like chore — boxes in boxes, micromanaging every tile. I enjoy micromanagement, but this inventory system and its ugly UI is just too cumbersome. This is a waste of the players time which bothers me too much. 

And don’t get me wrong — I love that you have to take care of everything: different batteries, ship-supplies, food, water, meds, sleep, even toilet, go ahead make it as complex as possible — but please just not that cumbersome.

It’s a pity such a great setting had to be so ugly and frustrating from a look & feel perspective. 

Ostranauts offers something rare: a raw, immersive experience where failure teaches, and every small victory feels earned.

I’ve spent a lot of time researching “Ostranauts-like” games — and while you’ll find suggestions, none truly offer what this game does. I genuinely believe that with a graphical and interface overhaul, Ostranauts could be something big

一颗有瑕疵的宝石，让我不断回来——但4年后，希望已逝。

Ostranauts是一款复杂、氛围深厚的游戏。我喜欢这个科幻设定——它感觉鲜活而扎实。系统错综复杂、相互交织，需要全神贯注。它营造的紧张感和沉浸感无与伦比。

我也非常喜欢那些面板和驾驶舱元素——拨动开关、管理飞船系统、操作老派界面，令人极其满足。

但是……它也丑得要命。UI笨拙且不直观。货物管理变成了一种惩罚性的类俄罗斯方块苦差事——箱子里套箱子，每个格子都要微操。我喜欢微操，但这个库存系统及其丑陋的UI实在太累赘了。这是在浪费玩家的时间，让我太在意了。

别误会——我喜欢你必须照顾一切：不同的电池、飞船补给、食物、水、药品、睡眠，甚至上厕所，尽管让它尽可能复杂——但请别那么累赘。

很遗憾，这么好的设定，从观感和手感的角度却不得不如此丑陋和令人沮丧。

Ostranauts提供了某种罕见的东西：一种原始、沉浸式的体验，失败能教会你东西，每一个小胜利都感觉是挣来的。

我花了很多时间研究“类Ostranauts”游戏——虽然你会找到一些推荐，但没有一个真正提供这款游戏所提供的东西。我真心相信，只要对画面和界面进行彻底改造，Ostranauts可以成为一款大作

items.text:
Look, I want to love this game. I should love this game. The atmosphere, the design, the mechanics – they're all weird and fascinating in a way that should hook me for hours. And yet... after multiple attempts, I'm still stuck in that awkward limbo between 'just wait for the game to get better' and 'screw it, just play through the jank and chaos.'

Every time I start a new run, something feels... missing. Not in the survival-horror-in-space way. I mean structurally. Like I'm piloting a half-finished ship built on ambition and duct tape.

I get that it's Early Access, and progress takes time. But it's hard to shake the feeling that this game's still searching for its core gameplay loop. Or maybe it's there, buried beneath layers of broken AI routines and menus that feel like they were designed as punishment.

All I’m asking is: when will this game finally feel complete enough to sink into? Right now it feels more like I’m bug-testing someone’s dream, not playing a game.

I don’t want perfection. I just want a stable foundation. Is that too much to ask... in space?

*In short, Sims in space. Quickly becoming my favorite game. Cant wait for the 1.0 so I can get lost again*

Let me tell you a story of me getting this game.
Several months ago I picked this up on sale, smoked a bowl and booted the game up, was digging the hell out of it, not really paying attention, took me like 2 hours to get to the point where I could get a ship lol. Feeling a little overwhelmed (remember high and the games pretty complicated) I wander around the station not really knowing wtf is going on or what im doing, trying to figure everything out and following the Tutorial. I sit in the cockpit and the nav screen clicks on and holy smokes! I am WAY to high to try to figure this ♥♥♥♥ out. Turned it off and played some Helldivers 2 probably. 

Recently ive been yearning for a solid Scifi RPG. Recently started playing Space Station 14 again, played SS13 over a decade ago a lot. But I commonly play lit and keeping up with the mostly chill vibe im looking for. I randomly saw Ostranauts in my list of games trying to find something to play and the cover art caught my eye so i booted it up, forgot all about it tbh. Didnt remember anything about the game (Playing high again lol), I sat down in the Nav console and OH CRAP THIS GAME AGAIN! and I closed it laughing. then i sat there and thought, "If I dont try it, I almost always play lit, ill never play it". So I launched it again and slowly learned what the hell I was doing lol. 

The next thing I know its 6am and im wide awake, went to sleep, woke up 6 hours later (I have insomnia and sometimes struggle to sleep or stay asleep) and start playing again. Literally the next thing I know it was 6 am again. This literally happened during the Presidents day weekend and most of the day before after work. 

This game is nearly everything I could have wanted in a space game. Im a big SciFi nerd and love Hard SciFi (Think more Expanse and less Star Trek) its just complicated enough for me to have to learn and feel accomplished. The first time a meteorite or something slammed into my hull taught me to compartmentalize, im trying to not save scum unless im testing a game system to make sure i get how it works. and forced me to react, I try to play real time when doing things, I speed up time when hauling and stuff. For me its a very immersive Space life sim, Im just my Character just trying to make it, no goals unless I want goals outside of making money for my loan. 

I have a tenancy of losing interest in games after 20 or so hours, rarely go games hold me for over 100 hours, Never in 1 fracking week lol. I understand this game is going 1.0 next year, I worry ill have the same problem I have with many EA games, Is I burn out on them and dont want to have to redo that part to see the new stuff, or too much time has passed and I forgot about it completely. This will be the first game I will tag for follow, I want to know everything about this game. However knowing thats a risk im getting all my enjoyment from it now, Assuming ill have to restart on 1.0, I hope I am just as enthralled with this game again. 

Now im not saying its not a buggy mess, complicated, many annoying UI issues, information that's hard to find (How ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ often is long term docking fees charged? whats the point of PDAs, etc), bad AI, Really cool conversation system but convoluted and hard to understand (Should take inspiration from the sims), not being able to tell your guy to auto build using specific materials, instead they will grab anything (so you have to build your ship manually if you want it looking a specific way) among many MANY issues. But even with all that, the times im not playing im thinking about what ill be going once I hop on, caught myself while out to dinner sketching out ship designs at Chilis lol. 

Im finally at the point where im docking my ship and tearing it all apart and building my Dream ship, Solo (No crew), and I want to have an outer hull with a technical corridors (with breaks using more TC) so when something hits me (Looking at you F*** Around and Find Out! MF has hit me 3 times and busted my ship.

I dont know if its accurate but it feels like Star Citizen/Elite Dangerous Meets Rimworld Meets The Sims all Single player. 

From what im reading the goals, this game will lose me, my body will be found at this computer with this game running... Mr EMS or my wife, please seal whatever leak killed me, I spent a lot of time and money on this ship, its all I have lol. 

Also good god how do you improve firearms use without blowing a hole in my suit every time?

*简而言之，太空版模拟人生。迅速成为我最喜欢的游戏。等不及1.0了，这样我就能再次迷失其中*

让我给你讲讲我得到这款游戏的故事。
几个月前，我在打折时买了它，抽了一碗，然后启动了游戏，玩得超级投入，没怎么注意，大概花了2个小时才达到能弄到一艘船的地步，哈哈。感觉有点不知所措（记得当时嗨了，而且游戏相当复杂），我在空间站里闲逛，不太知道到底发生了什么，也不知道自己在做什么，试图弄清楚一切并跟着教程走。我坐在驾驶舱里，导航屏幕亮了，我的天！我嗨得太过头了，根本没法搞明白这♥♥♥♥。关掉游戏，可能去玩了一些《地狱潜者2》。

最近我一直渴望一款扎实的科幻RPG。最近又开始玩《空间站14》，十多年前玩过很多《空间站13》。但我通常玩得比较嗨，保持着我所追求的那种大多时候很放松的氛围。我在游戏列表里随机看到《奥斯特拉诺茨》，想找点东西玩，封面艺术吸引了我的眼球，所以我启动了它，说实话，完全忘了它。不记得关于这游戏的任何事（又玩嗨了，哈哈），我坐在导航控制台前，哦靠，又是这游戏！我笑着关掉了。然后我坐在那里想，“如果我不尝试，我几乎总是玩嗨，我永远不会玩它”。所以我又启动了它，慢慢学会了我在搞什么鬼，哈哈。

接下来我知道的就是早上6点，我完全清醒，去睡觉，6小时后醒来（我有失眠症，有时难以入睡或保持睡眠），又开始玩。真的，接下来我知道的又是早上6点。这 literally 发生在总统日周末，以及之前下班后的大部分时间。

这款游戏几乎是我对太空游戏想要的一切。我是个超级科幻迷，喜欢硬科幻（想想更多《苍穹浩瀚》，少点《星际迷航》），它刚好复杂到让我必须学习并感到有成就感。第一次陨石或什么东西撞上我的船体，教会了我分区，我尽量不存档作弊，除非我在测试游戏系统以确保我明白它如何运作。并迫使我做出反应，我在做事时尽量实时玩，在运输东西时加速时间。对我来说，这是一个非常沉浸式的太空生活模拟，我只是我的角色，只是努力生存，除了为我的贷款赚钱之外，没有目标，除非我想要目标。

我有个倾向，在玩20小时左右后对游戏失去兴趣，很少有游戏能让我玩超过100小时，从来没有在1个该死的星期内，哈哈。我知道这款游戏明年要出1.0，我担心我会遇到许多EA游戏的问题，就是我会玩腻，不想重做那部分来看新内容，或者时间过得太久，我完全忘了它。这将是我第一个标记关注的游戏，我想知道关于这款游戏的一切。然而知道这是个风险，我现在就获取所有乐趣，假设我必须在1.0时重新开始，我希望我能再次如此着迷于这款游戏。

现在我不是说它不是个满是bug的烂摊子，复杂，许多烦人的UI问题，难以找到的信息（长期停靠费到底♥♥♥♥♥♥♥多久收一次？PDA有什么意义，等等），糟糕的AI，非常酷的对话系统但 convoluted 且难以理解（应该从模拟人生中汲取灵感），不能告诉你的角色使用特定材料自动建造，而是他们会抓任何东西（所以如果你想船看起来特定样子，你必须手动建造）以及许多许多问题。但即使有所有这些，我不玩的时候都在想我一上线会做什么，在Chilis外出吃饭时发现自己草图设计飞船，哈哈。

我终于到了停靠我的船，把它全部拆开，建造我的梦想船的地步，单人（无船员），我想要一个带有技术走廊的外壳（使用更多TC来断开），这样当什么东西撞到我时（说的就是你，F*** Around and Find Out！那混蛋撞了我3次，弄坏了我的船。

我不知道是否准确，但感觉像是《星际公民》/《精英危险》遇上《边缘世界》遇上《模拟人生》，全是单人。

从我读到的目标来看，这款游戏会失去我，我的尸体会被发现坐在这台电脑前，游戏还在运行……EMS先生或我妻子，请封住杀死我的泄漏，我在这艘船上花了大量时间和金钱，这是我的一切，哈哈。

还有天哪，你怎么提高枪械使用而不每次都在我的宇航服上炸个洞？
他们会随便抓取任何东西（所以如果你想让飞船看起来有特定的样子，就必须手动建造），这只是众多问题中的一小部分。但即便如此，当我不玩的时候，我都在想我一上线要做什么，有次在外面吃晚饭时，我发现自己竟然在Chilis餐厅里画飞船设计图，哈哈。

我终于到了把飞船停靠、全部拆开、建造我的梦想飞船的阶段，单人（无船员），我想要一个带有技术走廊的外壳（用更多TC来制造隔断），这样当有什么东西撞到我时（说的就是你，F*** Around and Find Out！那混蛋撞了我3次，把我的飞船搞坏了。

我不知道这准不准确，但感觉就像是《星际公民》/《精英危险》遇上《边缘世界》遇上《模拟人生》，全是单人模式。

从我读到的目标来看，这游戏会让我迷失，我的尸体会被发现坐在这台电脑前，游戏还开着……EMS先生或者我老婆，请把我因为什么泄漏而死的地方封住，我在这艘飞船上花了很多时间和金钱，这是我的一切了，哈哈。

还有天哪，你怎么才能在每次不把自己的宇航服打出一个洞的情况下提高枪械使用技能？

items.text:
Removed a wall while remodeling ship, forgot there was no floor underneath. Died for the first time in 40 hours of IRL playtime. Then suddenly don't feel like playing anymore. 

Would play again 10/10

.... but maybe in a year or so.

Game has an enjoyable gameplay loop. I'm all in for rags to riches type of game and this game delivers on that end, at least in the early game. It also nails it on the atmospheric end.
Which makes you want to actually be a little corporate drone.

However, the game is still full of bugs and jankiness. For example...
- the inventory UI overflows with containers if you're standing still and opening multiple containers, even if you don't have access to them. Containers should close once character doesn't have access to them, instead they get crossed out adding to the problem. So quite often you have to work around this jankiness by "refreshing" the UI via closing/reopening the inventory window.
- context menu hotkeys are always changing and some are dangerous, like jettison or bash. So you end up being extra careful or just clicking the option, which kind of defeats the purpose of hotkeys.
- context menu remains open after choosing an option, so you always need to move it out of the way or manually close it. Super awkward for a context menu.
- the longer you play the game, the worse the performance gets. I have a gaming PC that runs 4K 3D games without missing a heartbeat. Meanwhile this game manages to lag frequently.
- little weird bugs like something breaking all of the sudden that I just repaired to full health. 

... I could go on, but basically there are some questionable UI decisions that add jank to the game. Then the game is littered with bugs that you have to work around. And to top it off, the game is in bad need of some optimization. All in all, game is probably worth half of what it is in its current state. So, unless you want to pay to be QA, I'd say wait a while longer until the game is more stable.

Cool concept nonetheless.

这会让你真的想当一个小小的公司 drone。

然而，游戏仍然充满了 bug 和粗糙感。例如……
- 如果你站着不动并打开多个容器，即使你无权访问它们，物品栏 UI 也会被容器塞满。当角色不再有权访问容器时，它们应该关闭，但它们反而被划掉，加剧了问题。所以很多时候，你不得不通过关闭/重新打开物品栏窗口来“刷新”UI，以绕过这种粗糙感。
- 上下文菜单热键总是在变，而且有些很危险，比如抛弃或猛击。所以你最终会格外小心，或者干脆点击选项，这多少违背了热键的意义。
- 选择选项后上下文菜单仍然开着，所以你总是需要把它移开或手动关闭。对于一个上下文菜单来说，这超级别扭。
- 你玩得越久，性能就越差。我有一台能毫无压力运行 4K 3D 游戏的游戏 PC。与此同时，这款游戏却经常卡顿。
- 一些奇怪的小 bug，比如我刚修到满血的东西突然坏了。

……我还能继续说，但基本上，有一些可疑的 UI 决策给游戏增加了粗糙感。然后游戏里到处都是你不得不绕过的 bug。最要命的是，游戏急需一些优化。总而言之，以目前的状态，这游戏大概只值它售价的一半。所以，除非你想花钱当 QA，否则我建议再等一段时间，直到游戏更稳定。

不过概念还是很酷。

items.text:
If you enjoy games like Dwarf Fortress, Project Zomboid, and Rimworld then you'll probably enjoy this game quite a lot. Like all of those games you'll probably have to watch a little bit of a playthrough or a tutorial to really get a grasp of even the basic game mechanics. HOWEVER, once you put in the work this is easily one of the most rewarding games to play. 

The basic gameplay loop is as follows. You start off with a small dinky ship which (usually) immediately puts you around $500,000 to $800,000 in debt. Then you purchase a salvaging license (or don't), get in your ship, fly out to derelict ships, uninstall and repair the most expensive parts, fly back to base, sell everything, pay your bills, and repeat. But you don't have to sell the parts, instead, you can choose to install them and slowly improve your ship. This is the part I find to be the most rewarding. The ship I currently fly doesn't even remotely resemble what I started the game with even though it's technically the same ship. 

But if the game was as simple as that I wouldn't have the prerequisite of liking those other games. All of these systems are (usually) incredibly complex, or have surrounding systems that are complex. Just flying the ship requires you at least read the very short cheat sheet. But other things such knowing how to properly pressurize your ship and setting up a reactor have entire in-game fantasy manuals that read just like real ones. But it also knows exactly when to scale complexity back. Like installing additions to your ship is mainly a challenge of just having the correct parts and some time. It's the perfect thing to do while listening to music or a podcast or watching Youtube. 

There's so much I can't possibly mention all of it. You can take gigs, solve murders, flip ships, become a pirate, fight pirates, go to other planets, and I'm sure much much more that I haven't even discovered yet. 

But unfortunately as much as I would like for this review to be entirely positive there are a lot of issues and some seemingly unfinished or odd design decisions that I have to address. For instance, you can talk to and have relationships with other people you meet, with the ability to hire them as a crew. But the dialogue choices are really just a choice of whatever stat you want to raise or lower, and as a result a lot of conversations are entirely nonsensical. A back and forth might go like this (P = Player)
[list]
[*] P: How are you doing
[*] NPC: Lightly Touch
[*] P: Nod
[*] NPC: Savage Insult
[*] P: Yay!
[*] NPC: Shoot The Breeze
[*] P: Shoot The Breeze
[*] NPC: Shoot The Breeze
[*] P: Lightly Touch
[*] NPC: Savage Insult" [/list]

And if you keep that up you can make anyone your best friend. It seems oddly non-complex or unfinished for a game like this, And it isn't the only issue the dialogue has. Everyone including your character can only do one action at a time, and since talking counts as an action that means you can't speak to anyone while you or they are doing anything. You also have to be directly next to somebody to speak to them which means if an NPC is walking around you have to kind of awkwardly follow them until they stop walking, or intercept their path just to talk to them. An option to "call somebody over" like in The Sims would alleviate a lot of frustration there. My black market NPC has a set path back and forth between a cart and doing anything with them is a chore and a half just because they're constantly interacting with things (doors and the cart) and on the move. 

There's also one truly baffling UI decision which makes this game needlessly frustrating, the items in the context menu constantly change positions. Instead of having a hotkey to cancel an action you cancel it from the context menu, but it wants cancelling your task to be the first option (because you can't do anything else while doing something anyway). So it inserts "cancel action" at the top of the list, pushing all the other items and hotkeys down. This cancel action button shows up doing anything other than walking. Sometimes you'll set a path for your character to walk, then while they're walking try to tell them to do something, but because they had to open a door you accidentally told them to bash the object instead of something else.

This isn't even only a problem with cancel action because there are other instances where new items get added to the context list such as the "jettison" action. and I just don't understand why. There are 4 hotkeys for the first 4 actions, they should simply just be static. Every time you right click an object and press 3 it should repair it, I shouldn't have to EVER worry about that changing. Cancel action should just have a unique hotkey. I'm not saying it can't be in the context menu, but it has to be inserted BELOW all hotkeyed actions. This is easily one of my major frustrations with this game. 

And don't get it twisted, these aren't even close to the only frustrating issues. NPC crew mates are only "half-NPC" meaning they do things on their own, but you can also "fully control" them (you have to constantly fight their automatic actions to control them). However, they're incapable of actually taking care of themselves in any capacity. I have seen my NPC crew mate use a hygiene pack ONE TIME in a week, every other time I had to switch control to the NPC, feed them, make them drink, make them ♥♥♥♥, bathe them, swap the batteries in their equipment, Without my control they were essentially useless, stuck on an endless loop of working out for multiple hours straight, then sleeping (on the floor for some reason) until I wake them up to manually take care of their needs, only to repair ship at 1x speed because they're exhausted and sad from not taking care of themselves and endlessly working out, then after shift immediately go back to working out for hours until completely exhausted and sleeping again.

Then you dock at the port and even though they're on-shift they don't help you repair your haul they leave the ship and wander around watching TV's, talking to everyone, writing letters home, and quietly sobbing to themselves, even on auto task. Maybe I have to manually use the PDA to tell them to repair the loose items, but honestly I shouldn't have to, Eventually I had to uninstall all workout equipment but my crew mate still had the "at physical limits" moodlet for 2 entire days before I decided to just fire them because doing everything on my own was simply easier. I should not have to micromanage a crew mate this much, Taking care of your primary character is hard enough. 

I also just have to quickly mention the games performance is really bad. I have an AMD 5700, Intel i7 10700k 3.8GHz, and 32GB RAM and the game suffers from lag, stutters, freezing, and memory leaks. It's still entirely playable especially when compared to something like a heavily modded Zomboid, but I can imagine this game being a nightmare on a low-end PC. 

I could go on but I have to wrap this up. I think even in it's current state it's still worth recommending to a specific type of gamer. The game is currently in Early Access and receiving regular updates to fix bugs, tweak the UI, and more. I can live with certain oddities like the dialogue system, but some of these other issues have to be addressed. Still, I'm not disappointed in my purchase at all, Steam says I have 40 hours but I played about another 60 hours offline and I still want to play more. If this games modding scene grows the replayablility seems like it would be essentially infinite.
items.text_zh:
如果你喜欢《矮人要塞》、《僵尸毁灭工程》和《环世界》这类游戏，那你很可能会非常喜欢这款游戏。和所有这些游戏一样，你可能得看一点实况或教程，才能真正掌握哪怕是最基本的游戏机制。然而，一旦你投入了努力，这绝对是玩起来最有成就感的游戏之一。

基本的游戏循环如下。你一开始有一艘小小的破船，这（通常）会立刻让你背上大约50万到80万美元的债务。然后你购买一张打捞许可证（或者不买），登上你的船，飞到废弃船只那里，拆下并修理最贵的部件，飞回基地，卖掉一切，付清账单，然后重复。但你不一定非得卖掉那些部件，相反，你可以选择把它们安装上去，慢慢升级你的船。这是我觉得最有成就感的部分。我现在开的船和游戏开始时的那艘已经完全不像了，尽管从技术上讲它还是同一艘船。

但如果游戏就这么简单，我就不会把喜欢那些其他游戏作为前提条件了。所有这些系统（通常）都极其复杂，或者有围绕它们的复杂系统。光是开船就要求你至少读一读那份非常简短的速查表。但其他事情，比如知道如何正确地给你的船加压以及设置反应堆，都有完整的游戏内幻想手册，读起来就像真的一样。但它也完全知道什么时候该把复杂度降下来。比如给你的船安装附加部件，主要只是要有正确的零件和一些时间的挑战。这是听音乐、听播客或看YouTube时做的完美事情。

内容太多了，我不可能全部提到。你可以接活、破谋杀案、倒卖船只、当海盗、打海盗、去其他星球，而且我肯定还有更多更多我甚至还没发现的东西。

但不幸的是，尽管我很希望这篇评测全是正面的，但还是有很多问题，以及一些看似未完成或奇怪的设计决定，我必须得说一说。比如说，你可以和你遇到的其他角色交谈并建立关系，还能雇他们当船员。但对话选项实际上只是选择你想提升或降低哪项属性，结果就是很多对话完全莫名其妙。一来一回可能像这样（P = 玩家）
[list]
[*] P: 你好吗
[*] NPC: 轻轻触碰
[*] P: 点头
[*] NPC: 野蛮侮辱
[*] P: 耶！
[*] NPC: 闲聊
[*] P: 闲聊
[*] NPC: 闲聊
[*] P: 轻轻触碰
[*] NPC: 野蛮侮辱" [/list]

如果你一直这样下去，你可以让任何人成为你最好的朋友。对于这样一款游戏来说，这显得奇怪地不复杂或未完成，而且这还不是对话的唯一问题。每个人，包括你的角色，一次只能做一个动作，而既然说话也算一个动作，那就意味着当你或他们正在做任何事时，你都不能和任何人说话。你还必须紧挨着某人才能和他们说话，这意味着如果一个NPC在四处走动，你就得有点尴尬地跟着他们，直到他们停下脚步，或者拦住他们的去路才能跟他们说话。像《模拟人生》里那样一个“叫某人过来”的选项会缓解很多挫败感。我的黑市NPC有一条在推车之间来回的固定路线，和他们做任何事都麻烦得要命，就因为他们一直在和
东西（门和推车）并且在移动中。

还有一个真正令人费解的UI决定，让这款游戏变得毫无必要地令人沮丧，上下文菜单中的物品会不断改变位置。游戏没有设置取消动作的快捷键，而是让你从上下文菜单中取消，但它希望取消你的任务成为第一个选项（因为反正你在做某件事的时候也不能做其他事）。所以它把“取消动作”插入到列表顶部，把所有其他物品和快捷键都往下推。这个取消动作按钮在你做任何不是走路的事情时都会出现。有时候你会为你的角色设定一条行走路径，然后当他们正在走路时试图告诉他们去做某件事，但因为他们必须打开一扇门，你就不小心让他们去砸那个物体，而不是做别的事。

这甚至不只是取消动作的问题，因为还有其他情况会向上下文列表中添加新物品，比如“抛弃”动作。而我就是不明白为什么。前4个动作有4个快捷键，它们就应该只是固定的。每次你右键点击一个物体然后按3，它就应该修理它，我永远不应该担心那会改变。取消动作就应该有一个独特的快捷键。我不是说它不能出现在上下文菜单里，但它必须被插入到所有有快捷键的动作下面。这很容易成为我对这款游戏的主要不满之一。

别搞错了，这些甚至远不是唯一令人沮丧的问题。NPC船员只是“半个NPC”，意思是他们会自己做事情，但你也可以“完全控制”他们（你必须不断对抗他们的自动动作才能控制他们）。然而，他们完全无法以任何方式照顾自己。我见过我的NPC船员一周只用了一次卫生包，其他每次我都必须切换到控制那个NPC，喂他们，让他们喝水，让他们♥♥♥♥，给他们洗澡，更换他们装备里的电池。没有我的控制，他们基本上毫无用处，陷入一个无尽的循环：连续锻炼好几个小时，然后睡觉（不知为何睡在地板上），直到我叫醒他们来手动满足他们的需求，结果只能以1倍速度修理飞船，因为他们精疲力竭且悲伤，因为他们不照顾自己还无休止地锻炼，然后下班后立刻又回去锻炼好几个小时，直到完全精疲力竭又睡着。

然后你停靠在港口，即使他们在值班，他们也不帮你修理你的货物，他们离开飞船四处闲逛看电视、和每个人聊天、给家里写信，还悄悄地独自啜泣，即使是在自动任务模式下。也许我必须手动使用PDA告诉他们去修理散落的物品，但老实说我不应该非得这么做。最终我不得不卸载所有锻炼设备，但我的船员仍然带着“达到身体极限”的心情状态整整2天，之后我决定干脆解雇他们，因为自己做所有事情反而更简单。我不应该对一个船员进行这么多微观管理，照顾你的主要角色已经够难了。

我还必须快速提一下，游戏的性能真的很差。我有一块AMD 5700、Intel i7 10700k 3.8GHz和32GB内存，游戏却饱受延迟、卡顿、冻结和内存泄漏之苦。它仍然完全可以玩，尤其是和像打了大量模组的Zomboid之类的东西相比，但我能想象这款游戏在低端PC上会是一场噩梦。

我还可以继续说下去，但
我得把这篇收尾了。我觉得即使是在目前的状态下，它仍然值得推荐给某一类特定的玩家。这款游戏目前处于抢先体验阶段，并且会定期更新来修复bug、调整UI等等。对话系统之类的某些古怪之处我可以忍受，但其他一些问题必须得到解决。不过，我对自己的购买完全不失望，Steam显示我玩了40小时，但我离线又玩了大约60小时，而且我还想继续玩。如果这款游戏的模组社区发展起来，重玩性似乎基本上会是无限的。

items.text:
This is way too rough to recommend.  It's the kind of game you can play hundreds of hours of because you see the great game inside but the whole time you're thinking why is this so janky?

I know the game has come a long way but that only raises the question - just how messed up was it before if it's still this awkward?

Executive summary:

1. UI is ugly as sin.  I am a fan of ASCII games and can tolerate pain.  Everything looks like a working prototype that was made by someone who wished they were working on something else.
2. Bizarre game logic.  NPCs exist but any depth is only puddle deep once to enter a polycule with everyone you meet and the only thing to discuss is strange meat.
3. Lack of progression.  Want to upgrade your ship?  It's more of the same ♥♥♥♥ your ship has.  You're never getting meaningful upgrades just more of the same stuff you already have.  The spark of excitement when hitting a new derelict just isn't there.
4.  Lots of strange bugs that require you to at best save and quit the game, and at worst just accept your save file is gunked.

Overall, 6/10.
Slightly worse than NEO Scavenger.  Will probably improve in the future and the review score will increase.  

Please hire me to be your annoying mother that tells you to do the chores.  There's so many half baked or half implemented ideas that mar a game that would be brilliant.

"You've played an additional 43 hours would you like to change your review?"
I have finally hit my limit of bugs breaking the game.  I don't have the energy to power through them anymore and I quit.

这游戏太粗糙了，没法推荐。这是那种你能玩上几百小时的游戏，因为你能看到里面那款很棒的游戏，但整个过程你都在想：为什么这么蹩脚？

我知道这游戏已经进步了很多，但这只会引出一个问题——如果它现在还是这么别扭，那以前得糟糕成什么样？

内容摘要：

1. UI 丑得要命。我是 ASCII 游戏的粉丝，能忍受痛苦。但一切看起来都像是一个工作原型，做它的人巴不得自己在做别的东西。
2. 诡异的游戏逻辑。NPC 是存在，但任何深度都只有水坑那么浅，一旦你和你遇到的每个人都进入多人关系，唯一能聊的就是奇怪的肉。
3. 缺乏成长。想升级你的飞船？不过是你的飞船已有的那些♥♥♥♥的更多同类。你永远得不到有意义的升级，只是更多你已经拥有的东西。撞上一艘新的废弃飞船时那种兴奋的火花根本不存在。
4. 大量奇怪的 bug，最好的情况是要求你存档退出游戏，最坏的情况是你只能接受你的存档已经废了。

总体，6/10。
比《NEO Scavenger》稍差。未来可能会改进，评测分数也会上升。

请雇我来当那个烦人的妈妈，叫你去干家务。有太多半生不熟或半途而废的点子，毁了一款本可以很出色的游戏。

“你又玩了 43 小时，要修改你的评测吗？”
我终于到了被破坏游戏的 bug 逼到的极限。我再也没有精力硬撑过去了，我退坑了。

我真的很想喜欢这款游戏，对于这么一个简单的游戏概念来说，它复杂得可怕。

不过，复杂并不是让我远离它的原因，因为我确实喜欢复杂的游戏来保持头脑清醒和接受挑战。然而，当你拿到自己的飞船，飞到另一艘飞船并第一次尝试对接时，我就被软锁了。提示告诉你在夹钳亮绿灯时关闭它们，但它们从来不变绿，除此之外，通讯还不停地哔哔响，说没有对接端口，即使我刚刚收到了对接许可。

我花了将近一个小时试图对接上那该死的东西。

我不会以后再回来玩这款游戏了，这一切都发生在游戏的头5分钟里。如果我 literally 在一开始就被进度锁住了，我甚至不想知道游戏里还有哪些其他类型的bug。

items.text:
I spend a significant amount of time masturbating in my ship and watching porn during LAN parties because my need for intimacy is shockingly strong. Naturally, I'm having a great time. (Try to avoid lustful traits)

The learning curve isn't as steep as folks claim and I wouldn't say the devs inhibit success right from the gate, but the sooner you embrace failure the better - experimentation is important; however, this isn't a "dying is fun" kind of game. There's no ten hours of failure before you learn how to operate an airlock.

While I can't praise the immersive UI enough, I do wish for a more QoL regarding window placement and tracking which window belongs to which container. Some elements are far larger than they should be and it gets very messy very quickly, especially with cargo pants.

I also fear for mid- and late-game depth as distant areas seem to be more of the same, but Ostranauts is a sandbox and is what you make of it. You'll almost certainly be derelict ship harvester with the occasional detective job (don't get too excited, it's very basic) and eventually save up enough money for a home and cargo ship to shuttle bulk goods from A to B. In a nutshell, that's the game. The rest lies in immersion, roleplay, and a bit of imagination.
