items.text:
If you can't stand buggy games, don't try this game, or EA releases in general. It is playable, but it will slowly break down. Every 1 in 10 station visits, my ship would disappear from the airlock, and the station's atmosphere would mysteriously vent into space, slowly killing all the essential NPCs inside.

But I only rate EA based on potential, and this has good potential.

Still, the game is quite unwieldy. That should be addressed right after making the game run smoother. I'm talking about the unintentionally unwieldy parts, btw.

Some of the game is intentionally unwieldy: flying your ship & managing ship systems in general. You're an unlicensed ship breaker working with nav systems and nuclear reactors (almost literally) made in China. To navigate from point to point, you need to get acquainted with a console with about 35 analog switches, mostly with brief labels like STN, BRY, BRG, & ANT, that require you to read a manual in-game to understand what each button does. It's not remotely difficult, but it is not as simple as right-click fast travel, or piloting a car in space. It may not sound like it, but it is quite fun, and could be the focus of a whole other game.

Some parts of the game are unintentionally unwieldy. For example, to designate floors for installation, you have to
(1) open your PDA
(2) open the Install app
(3) go to the Hull menu
(4) scroll until you find your floor tile (there's about 48 items in that menu, no search bar or categories)
(5) wiggle your cursor to every square you want floors installed to (there is no click-drag bounding box feature)
Did something interrupt you, or did you want to get a better look and have to close the menu? You need to repeat all that clicking to get the floor again.

To order a crew member to uninstall a wall-lamp, you have to:
(1) open your PDA
(2) open the Orders app
(3) untick the five other categories, only leaving POWER on, otherwise you might uninstall the floor on the same tile as the wall lamp
(4) click uninstall
(5) find the wall lamp in the world again, and left click it

As you can see, unwieldy.

IMO first priority should be to
(1) make saving and loading much much faster
(2) make loading from the menu possible
this is so we can quickly test the game and write quality bug reports, since the devs said that they are in the "hardening" phase of development
items.text_zh:
如果你受不了有bug的游戏，就别试这款游戏，或者别碰EA发行的一般作品。它是能玩的，但会慢慢崩坏。每10次到站访问中就有1次，我的飞船会从气闸处消失，空间站的大气会神秘地泄漏到太空中，慢慢杀死里面所有重要的NPC。

但我只根据潜力来评价EA，而这款游戏潜力不错。

不过，游戏还是相当笨重。这应该在让游戏运行更流畅之后马上解决。顺便说一句，我说的是那些非故意的笨重部分。

游戏有些部分是有意笨重的：驾驶飞船以及总体管理飞船系统。你是一个无证拆船工，操作着（几乎字面意义上）中国制造的导航系统和核反应堆。要从一个点导航到另一个点，你需要熟悉一个大约有35个模拟开关的控制台，大多数开关只有像STN、BRY、BRG和ANT这样的简短标签，需要你阅读游戏内手册才能理解每个按钮的作用。这远不算难，但也不像右键快速旅行或在太空中驾驶汽车那么简单。听起来可能不像，但这相当有趣，而且可以成为另一款完整游戏的核心。

游戏有些部分是非故意笨重的。例如，要指定安装地板的位置，你必须
(1) 打开你的PDA
(2) 打开Install应用
(3) 进入Hull菜单
(4) 滚动直到找到你的地板砖（那个菜单里大约有48个项目，没有搜索栏或分类）
(5) 把光标挪到每一个你想安装地板的方格上（没有点击拖拽的框选功能）
有事情打断你了吗，还是你想看得更清楚而不得不关闭菜单？你需要重复所有这些点击才能再次找到那块地板。

要命令一名船员卸下一盏壁灯，你必须：
(1) 打开你的PDA
(2) 打开Orders应用
(3) 取消勾选其他五个类别，只留下POWER，否则你可能会卸下与壁灯同一格的地板
(4) 点击卸载
(5) 在世界中再次找到那盏壁灯，然后左键点击它

如你所见，很笨重。

在我看来，首要任务应该是
(1) 让保存和加载快得多得多
(2) 让从菜单加载成为可能
这样我们就能快速测试游戏并写出高质量的bug报告，因为开发者说他们正处于开发的“加固”阶段

On paper, this kind of crunchy space scavenger game is exactly what i want.
In practice, you end up spending more time with the god awful UI design than you do actually making any progress.
When you do figure out anything, you realize how much effort it takes to do even the most basic actions.
Definitely not for me, and I have hundreds of hours in CDDA.

The menus are awful, the interface is cluttered, and the tutorials are a joke.
Even just trying to look around and SEE whats in a ship is painful. Is that tiny sprite storage? Is it worth anything? Did you just target a person? Here's 100 status effects they have good luck parsing out useful information in this cluttered hell.

Theres just too much going and not enough game going on, I don't feel the fun, what I do feel is a deep disconnection from reality as I try to understand this UI. This game should be taken as a lesson on what NOT to do in your crunchy space game.

items.text:
[i]warning BLEEP crash KRUNCH rrrrrrr[/i]

"Kaylee...Was that my primary b-"

"No, no, everything's shiny, Captain! Just a microasteroid collision!"

"...Then why did I just see one of my shuttles...You know what, never mind. Just fix it."

TL;DR: I like it, and I'm having fun banging my head against the wall. 

This is set in a post-apocalyptic scenario, with a "hard" sci-fi setting with some elements of other genres sprinkled in (including a wee soupçon of eldritch horror). You play as a "shipbreaker" - an independent salvager - who takes their little deathtrap boat out to find derelict spacecraft in hopes of stripping them clean of any and all of its valuables...Whether that be a nice EVA suit with a shiny gun and some booze, a ship's reactor and batteries, or literally the walls and floors themselves.

This is a game with lots of procedurally-generated content about setting out into space from your cozy little home base on a station to make your fortune...and, more importantly, pay off the mortgage on your salvage boat. Or, ya know, try not to get killed by the criminals you stole it from. Either/or. 

Wander around the space station, chatting with and befriending/pissing off the locals. See the sights! Hack the secured doors! Break and Enter! [strike]Steal[/strike] Appropriate stuff or just drag the entire storage bin over to your ship! Hell, you can even hack the airlock and [i]cough wheeze[/i] ...there are so many [i]gasp[/i]...stars...

You can use the salvaged stuff to sell, or to fix up and expand your own ship. You can also purchase derelicts you find if you've got the dough. Inventory management also matters, as different gear has differing amounts of space to hold stuff -- and, at least for your ship, weight matters; make sure you have enough thrusters duct-taped to the hull and the bits and bobs inside you need to move that hunk of junk around. 

The game is intended to be difficult, so fair warning there. There are some stations and ships to visit and shop at/steal from/chat with people, ways to improve your character over time by training or study, nosy space cops, and of course, pirates out to take what you rightfully [strike]stole[/strike] salvaged.

It has a steep learning curve when it comes to spaceflight, but it's well-documented. That manual on the title screen isn't just for show ^_^ The game also has in-universe books, pamphlets, posters, and hastily-scribbled notes to find. That being said, the flight interface is downright obtuse, so read that documentation and maybe look up a guide or two. A game manual of sorts is right there on the title screen, and has a bunch of useful info.

The atmosphere and style is informed by media such as space operas, space westerns such as Cowboy Bebop and (quite visibly) Firefly, and many others. There are also some creeptastic bits of lore and quests to find...if they don't find you first.

ProTip: On the bottom-right of the ship control screen: Drop the throttle slider really low in order to avoid having the G-forces from using the thrusters screw over your character. Adjust it upwards in tiny increments to find a safe level to use.

All in all, a solid game with plenty of potential, and I'm looking forward to its eventual 1.0 release in the future!

items.text_zh:
[i]警告 哔哔 撞击 咔嚓 呜呜呜呜呜[/i]

“凯莉……那是我的主——吗？”

“不，不，一切都好，船长！只是一次微型小行星碰撞！”

“……那我刚才为什么看到我的一艘穿梭机……算了，当我没说。把它修好就行。”

长话短说：我喜欢它，而且我正玩得很开心，一边拿头撞墙。

本作设定在后末日场景中，带有“硬”科幻设定，还撒了点其他类型的元素（包括一丁点儿诡异恐怖）。你扮演一名“拆船工”——一个独立打捞者——开着自己那艘小破死亡陷阱船出去寻找废弃航天器，希望能把它们身上所有值钱的东西扒得一干二净……不管是带闪亮枪械和几瓶酒的漂亮EVA服、飞船反应堆和电池，还是字面意义上的墙壁和地板本身。

这是一款包含大量程序生成内容的游戏，讲的是从你在空间站上舒适的小小基地出发，进入太空发财……更重要的是，还清你那艘打捞船的贷款。或者，你知道的，尽量别被那些你偷了船的家伙杀掉。二者皆可。

在空间站里四处闲逛，和当地人聊天、交朋友/惹毛他们。看看风景！黑进安全门！破门而入！[strike]偷[/strike] 征用东西，或者干脆把整个储物箱拖到你的船上！见鬼，你甚至还能黑进气闸，然后 [i]咳咳 喘喘[/i]……有好多好多 [i]喘气[/i]……星星……

你可以把打捞来的东西卖掉，或者用来修理和扩建自己的飞船。如果你有钱，也可以购买你发现的废弃船。物品栏管理也很重要，因为不同装备能装东西的空间不同——而且，至少对你的飞船来说，重量很重要；确保你有足够多的推进器用胶带绑在船体上，船里也有你需要的零碎部件来推动那坨废铁。

这游戏本来就打算做得很难，所以先提醒一下。有一些空间站和飞船可以拜访，并在那里购物/偷东西/和人聊天；有随着时间推移通过训练或学习来提升角色的方法；有爱管闲事的太空警察；当然，还有想拿走你合法[strike]偷来[/strike]打捞来的东西的海盗。

太空飞行方面学习曲线很陡，但文档写得很充分。标题画面上的那本手册可不只是摆设 ^_^ 游戏里还有世界观内的书籍、小册子、海报和匆匆写下的笔记可供寻找。话虽如此，飞行界面简直晦涩难懂，所以请读那些文档，也许再查一两篇指南。标题画面上就有一本类似游戏手册的东西，里面有一堆有用信息。

氛围和风格受到太空歌剧、太空西部片如《星际牛仔》以及（非常明显地）《萤火虫》等许多媒体的影响。还有一些令人毛骨悚然的背景设定和任务可供发现……如果它们没有先找到你的话。

专业提示：在飞船控制界面右下角：把油门滑块降得非常低，以避免使用推进器产生的G力把你的角色搞垮。再以极小增量向上调整，找到安全的使用水平。

总而言之，这是一款扎实、潜力十足的游戏，我期待它未来最终发布1.0版！

items.text:
Ostranauts is a top down 2d space scavenger game with ship building mechanics and a simple atmosphere and orbital dynamics simulator. It also looks like there is the intent to have heat simulation and some crew interaction simulation. There is a hypothetical long range travel,  but its bugged out of any usefulness and despite dozens of attempts I failed to make the autopilot get me anywhere near anywhere else. Note that you have to use the autopilot as you cannot manually use the long range drive. That the characters die unless you manually feed them every few hours also make long distance travel atrociously annoying. It would be so simple to have them auto consume food, water and sleep when fast forwarding, but instead they just randomly die. 

and cant really say anything about it. The main game loop consists of scavenging various derelicts and building up your ship, and paying of the loans you have on the starting ship, avoiding spending too much on fuel and oxygen. This aspect is somewhat fun, but the main difficulty of the game is essentially remembering where you stored something. This makes building and repair with spare parts tedious. It would be a good idea to keep track of only a few kinds of mechanically different floors, and keep the texture of the floor separate from the type, and the same holds for walls. The shipbuilding is fun but due to storage mechanics rather tedious. The power mechanics are very opaque and there is no way to see how much something will draw. There is a system for character progression, well maybe, it still levels up the skills you already have, and when they finally reach 100% you never get anything for it, but it does look like its there... The amount of work needed is also wildly varying and disproportionate. Combat and conversation is lousy, again mostly due to bad ui. It would be better if you entered into a  different kind of menu for it, rather than needing to scroll around and guess what things do. 

There should also be difficulty related to managing food, drink and atmosphere and heat, but these systems are nearly trivial to maintain, or bugged. There is also no recycling of food drink wast etc, no greenhouses, and strangely no solar panels or radio isotope generators. The occasional loss of power, or fuel, or crashing nav station are all fun things mini events but can be a bit too punishing in some cases. 

There is an interesting character creation process, but its rather limited, and without knowing what anything does its less fun. 

The problem is the bugs. Bugs like your character equiping a space helmet for no clear reason and then falling unconsious once the air runs out while inside your ship where the atmosphere is fine. Bugs like the various character status bars being difficult to intrepet, or again bugged. Bugs like not needing to go to the bathroom for months before suddenly nearly dying due to not having been in the last few minutes over and over again. Bugs like station personel dropping like flies if you stick around for a few hours, leaving their valuables behind.  Bugs like losing the ability to left click on things, which is the main mode of interaction, bugs like the character randomly committing suicide in various ways. The game is also astonishingly slow to load and save which is the only way to fix most bugs. Please upgrade to protobufs with an arena and stop using zipped jsons... Also the game badly needs longer range for a* when searching for valid paths and valid haul locations. 

The game is really promising, but just not ready for release yet. If you are willing to live with alot of unintuitive ui, jank the game is fun as is, but it still needs alot of work.

《Ostranauts》是一款俯视视角的2D太空打捞游戏，带有飞船建造机制，以及一个简单的大气与轨道动力学模拟器。看起来它还打算加入热量模拟和一些船员互动模拟。游戏里有一种假想中的远距离航行，但它已经bug到毫无用处，尽管我尝试了几十次，还是没能让自动驾驶把我带到任何其他地方附近。注意，你必须使用自动驾驶，因为你无法手动使用远距离驱动器。角色除非你每隔几小时手动喂他们一次，否则就会死，这也让远距离航行变得极其烦人。在快进时让他们自动消耗食物、水和睡觉本该是件很简单的事，但他们却只会随机死掉。

而且对此真的没什么可说的。主游戏循环包括打捞各种废弃飞船、逐步建造自己的飞船、偿还你在初始飞船上的贷款，同时避免在燃料和氧气上花太多钱。这方面还算有点意思，但游戏的主要难点本质上就是记住你把某样东西放在哪里了。这让用备用零件进行建造和修理变得很繁琐。只追踪少数几种在机制上不同的地板，并把地板贴图与类型分开，会是个好主意，墙壁也是如此。造船很有趣，但由于存储机制而相当繁琐。电力机制非常不透明，而且没有办法看到某样东西会消耗多少电。有一个角色成长系统，嗯，也许吧，它仍然会提升你已经拥有的技能，而当它们终于达到100%时，你什么也得不到，但它看起来确实存在……所需的工作量也变化极大且不成比例。战斗和对话很糟糕，同样主要是因为糟糕的UI。如果进入一种不同类型的菜单来处理这些，而不是需要四处滚动并猜测东西是干什么的，那会更好。

还应该有与管理食物、饮水、大气和热量相关的难度，但这些系统维护起来几乎微不足道，或者就是有bug。也没有食物、饮水、废物等的回收利用，没有温室，而且奇怪的是没有太阳能板或放射性同位素发电机。偶尔的断电、断燃料或导航站崩溃都是有趣的迷你事件，但在某些情况下可能惩罚过重。

有一个有趣的角色创建过程，但它相当有限，而且在不知道任何东西是干什么的情况下，乐趣也会减少。

问题在于bug。比如你的角色毫无明确理由地装备上太空头盔，然后在空气耗尽后失去意识，而当时你还在自己飞船内部，那里的大气明明没问题。比如各种角色状态条难以解读，或者同样有bug。比如几个月都不需要上厕所，然后突然因为过去几分钟内没上过厕所而反复濒临死亡。比如如果你在某个地方待上几个小时，空间站人员就会像苍蝇一样倒下，留下他们的贵重物品。比如失去左键点击物体的能力，而这是主要的交互方式；比如角色以各种方式随机自杀。游戏加载和保存也慢得惊人，而这是修复大多数bug的唯一方法。请升级到带arena的protobuf，别再使用压缩的json了……另外，游戏在搜索有效路径和有效拖运位置时，非常需要为A*提供更长的搜索范围。

这款游戏真的很有前景，但还没准备好发布。如果你愿意忍受大量不直观的UI和粗糙感，游戏目前这样也挺好玩，但它仍然需要大量工作。

A bit clunky, a lot cluttered, not very clear. However, these are all acceptable for an early access game. 
The game itself? GET IT
If you're the kind of person who likes manuals, games like Rings of Saturn, or is a hard sci-fi fan. 

In my opinion needs workshop support to get the perfect experience. Mods to create custom characters for example. You can do that now of course, but you're fairly limited imo.

Also needs a better social interaction system, not necessarily a complete overhaul but pretty close.

You can put on a pressure suit, uninstall a floor tile, and space an entire station 30 seconds into the game. The only  thing that will stop you is if a security guard spots you, in which case a pop-up event will happen, you will age 3 or so years in prison, and then you're right back to the same spaced space station, seconds after you got arrested, to which everyone without a pressure suit or Eva suit proceeds to die. You have no further consequences.

Also, despite having a "slow metabolism" why does my character get SO hungry? Compared to thirst, hunger is RAPID. You'll need 2-3 meals before a drink of water.

Combat is also in the same boat. Somehow a pirate will be fine alone on a hunk of junk floating in space, no starvation/dehydration or environment exposure, who then is completely fine to try and murder you for your stuff. Except somehow it's very easy to win by just spamming a stab attack. At which point if they don't surrender, they die. If they do surrender, they hop aboard your ship as they slowly bleed out, and then randomly turn hostile again as if you didn't just nearly kill them before halfway back to the station. (I think there are handcuffs but i've never found any if so)

Also I don't know if there is any ship-to-ship combat but if not there NEEDS to be. Even if it's a dlc it's a must.

Runs well too, my gpu died recently and with some minor adjustments the game ran fine on my igpu, and looked pretty good still too.

Translation issues, and would be nice to be able to choose one language at a time, right now it shows both of them at once most of the time. Objects, npc's, and you are referred to as 'us' for details and status effect descriptions.

Also, you can spend an entire year of your life in character customization to maybe raise a few hundred dollars, but you can spend 2 irl minutes the second you get into the game to do a delivery gig that takes like 20 seconds and awards thousands if you do it fast? (as in, pause scumming to save every second spent in menus or inventory. If you dont It's not actually possible to get the highest payment tier from what i've seen)

Lot's of issues that need addressing, but the core game is actually quite well done. As long as they address the small issues, my review will remain positive, 

They also are great at fixing all the small stuff, tons of updates with tons of goodies, so far.

有点笨拙，非常杂乱，不太清晰。不过，对于一款抢先体验游戏来说，这些都是可以接受的。
游戏本身呢？买它
如果你是那种喜欢说明书的人，喜欢《土星环》这类游戏，或者是个硬科幻迷。

在我看来，需要创意工坊支持才能获得完美体验。比如用模组创建自定义角色。当然你现在也能这么做，但我觉得相当受限。

还需要更好的社交互动系统，不一定要彻底重做，但也差不多了。

你可以在游戏开始30秒内穿上压力服，拆下一块地板砖，把整个空间站扔进太空。唯一能阻止你的是被保安发现，那样会触发一个弹窗事件，你会在监狱里度过大约3年，然后你立刻又回到那个被扔进太空的空间站，就在你被捕几秒之后，所有没有压力服或EVA服的人都会死掉。你没有进一步的后果。

还有，明明有“新陈代谢缓慢”，为什么我的角色还是那么饿？和口渴相比，饥饿来得太快了。喝一杯水之前你得吃2-3顿饭。

战斗也是同样的情况。不知怎么的，一个海盗独自待在一块漂浮在太空中的破铜烂铁上会安然无恙，没有饥饿/脱水或环境暴露的问题，然后他完全有精力为了你的东西试图谋杀你。只不过不知为何，只要狂点刺击攻击就很容易赢。到那时，如果他们不投降，就会死。如果他们投降了，他们会一边慢慢流血一边跳上你的船，然后在回空间站半路上又随机变得敌对，就好像你刚才没有差点杀了他们一样。（我想是有手铐的，但如果有的话我从没找到过）

还有，我不知道有没有舰对舰战斗，但如果没有的话，那必须有。就算是DLC也必须有。

运行也很流畅，我的显卡最近坏了，稍微调整了一下，游戏在我的核显上运行得很好，看起来也依然相当不错。

翻译问题，而且能一次只选一种语言就好了，现在大多数时候两种语言会同时显示。物体、NPC和你自己在细节和状态效果描述中都被称为“我们”。

还有，你可以在角色自定义上花掉一整年的生命，也许只能多赚几百美元，但你可以在进入游戏后的2分钟现实时间里接一个送货任务，任务耗时大概20秒，如果做得快就能奖励数千美元？（也就是说，通过暂停刷时间来节省在菜单或物品栏里花费的每一秒。如果你不这么做，据我所见，实际上不可能拿到最高报酬等级）

有很多问题需要解决，但核心游戏其实做得相当不错。只要他们解决这些小问题，我的评价就会保持正面。

他们也很擅长修复所有小问题，到目前为止有大量更新和大量好东西。

I recommend Ostranauts, however it is not a game that will appeal to most gamers, because it is a game about slowly getting by, tediously plotting through space and the game.
The game is certainly not suitable for those looking for a fun quick space game fix for a few moments.
The game demands you plod along at its pace, and is extreme in its detail but that is its charm as you plan your next run, hoping the rust bucket you are paying horrendous fees to use wont end up as another derelict for some other scavenger to find a tear apart for a profit.

The game is doesn’t have the best graphics, but does have a odd charm and the control panels just make me feel like I have somehow got into a spaceship and looking at the wild array of buttons and switches… no cockpit view here, its all on the multi function display, and lots of numbers.
The atmosphere is great as well, from long waits to sudden proximity alarms, the creak of the rust bucket as you hit the RCS thrusters to manoeuvrer  for docking.

Game is also not one for players that want a easy to learn game, its learning curve is rather steep and it doesn’t help you that much, though all the information you need is in the in-game manual (nicely disguised as a company training and operations manual).
If you can learn to get along with the game you will find yourself losing hours of time while trying to get your character to a comfortable lifestyle … but first you need to pay off the bills, fend off the odd pirate and deal with the business of a derelict scavenger.

I suggest you watch a few YT vids of others playing the game to see if you will enjoy it, and get a head start on the learning curve.
(As of the date of this review the latest version is 0.14 – next phase is planning fires, ship weapons and explosions)

I really WANT to like this game. The concept is neat, the depth is really cool, but it's being desperately held back by an EXTREMELY un-intuitive interface and UI. The skeuomorphic way you fly your ship is really neat, but the controls are deliberately obtuse and complicated and it makes it a nightmare to try and get into for new players.

This is on top of social interaction and character moodlets offering little to no information about what they actually do either. The top-down perspective also obscures what the hell you're looking at, which can be a real pain if you're trying to tell a battery charger from the O2 pressure alarm from a power switch from- You get the idea.

The game is for the truly hardcore ONLY and I have a serious case of buyer's regret since I tried to stick with it well past the return time-limit and make it work for me, only to discover that by looking too hard at the mystery meat in my space food, I'd introduced some lovecraftian abomination to my game that makes salvaging wrecks even HARDER. No thanks.

Whilst this game could allow for a lot replayability it has problems.

It lacks basic features that would improve the game a lot, it is needlessly complicated in some areas and front loaded. Yet somehow shallow. It lacks info about what anything does, like player traits.

Here is some simple things, what I think it needs as a priority:
Unable to quit to main menu from character creation, in case you pressed wrong button or wanna try again. 'Continue' on titlescreen is often for continuing a last save, should probably be called 'load'.
For some reason container items need to be interacting with and you need to select 'inventory'. Look I love inventory management, heck I love CDDA, but requiring the game to be unpaused to look at your items is not good. I cannot stress the amount this reduced my enjoyment. Having to check everythings inventory is tedious.
Unable to label or change name of items, that glass bottle of 'vodka' you have for coffee? Yeah your gonna have to use the previous inventory checking each time you want to go through your stuff, as you can't tell at a glance what's in it?
Using control to pick up single items from a stack is impossible, you use control to instead 'place' one from the stack? Seems backwards.
Kicks you out of nav panel on ships when closing the ship menu, very annoying when you are learning the game and after still annoying.
No way to 'cancel' a move command easily.
The ship travel menu is a mess, trying to move around the map is sensitive and annoying, Trying to figure out your heading AND viewing your target is very difficult. This COULD be forgiven if better navigation parts are added later, but I seriously doubt such poor UI would be on every ship in galaxy. You can't even get predictions on where an object is travel that you have targeted, or even the angle between you and the target.

Other areas to improve:
The OST is not very good, it could use better music. I turned it off after a bit. The first one is good for the character creation though.
Traits that do nothing.
Poor variety of items and parts, every ship starts to look the same in terms of parts.
All ships have the same UI?
Some traits or skills aren't trainable?
Unclear to the players when stuff needs to be paid.
No 'buffer' for new characters from fees, means 100% your first character you spent time on will be a waste, should be able to 'pre' save already built characters with same parents, etc.
Changing your last name does not affect your origins.
All the 'mothers' I get look like dudes, tested 8/10 times, same with weird looking fathers. Why assign parents at all? They don't appear to affect your story in the slightest? Character creation options are limited, n general the options for females in particular are bad, I tried playing a few times and once it gave me a female character, after wasting time making a character I realised that it just puts a different face only, it kinda looks goofy on top of the default male body. But across the board it is lacking, you can't even make a character that looks like the loading screens... or even 'normal' looking.
The loan system for your ship seems a bit weird? You can loan for a $800,000 ship, but can't for a $80,000 + some extra like gear? Or a license? I dunno man. Stuff doesn't make sense, in the description of one ship it mentions you worked on it... why can't you work on the cheapest ship?
The LONG saving times, are an issue.
The character creation is sometimes annoying, 'seek ship' should not show the same ship more then once, even if it adds more time the next time you look.
NPCs steal your items? Items disappearing? Had to reload as a core item like my helmet disappeared.
Uninstalling parts in your ship and they appear outside the ship... serious issue as there is no way to go outside? Even from port?


I tried to enjoy this game as it seems to have all the elements for a game I would enjoy but it is half baked at least for now and I just don't. It ain't even that deep either, even though it seems complicated up front, once you play a little bit it is a really simple game.

Still all that said I still think this will be a good game after some updates, unfortunately from what I can see that would take at least 3 years at current rate of development to where I would consider this game playable.
items.text_zh:
虽然这款游戏可能允许大量重复游玩，但它存在问题。

它缺乏能大幅改善游戏的基础功能，在某些方面不必要地复杂且前置内容过多。然而不知怎的又很浅薄。它缺乏关于任何东西作用的说明，比如玩家特质。

以下是一些简单的事情，我认为它需要优先处理：
无法从角色创建退出到主菜单，以防你按错了按钮或想再试一次。标题画面上的“继续”通常是用来继续上次存档的，可能应该叫“加载”。
不知为何容器物品需要与之互动，然后你需要选择“库存”。听着，我喜欢库存管理，见鬼，我喜欢CDDA，但要求游戏取消暂停才能查看你的物品并不好。我无法强调这减少了我多少乐趣。不得不检查每样东西的库存很乏味。
无法给物品贴标签或更改名称，你那瓶用来配咖啡的“伏特加”玻璃瓶？是啊，每次你想翻找你的东西时，都得用之前说的检查库存，因为你无法一眼看出里面是什么？
使用control从一堆物品中拾取单个物品是不可能的，你用control反而是从堆里“放置”一个？似乎反了。
在飞船上关闭飞船菜单时，会把你踢出导航面板，在你学习游戏时非常烦人，之后仍然烦人。
没有简单的方法“取消”移动命令。
飞船旅行菜单一团糟，试图在地图上移动既敏感又烦人，试图弄清你的航向同时查看你的目标非常困难。如果以后加入更好的导航部件，这还可以原谅，但我严重怀疑银河系每艘飞船上都会有这么糟糕的UI。你甚至无法获得你所瞄准物体移动方向的预测，甚至无法获得你与目标之间的角度。

其他需要改进的地方：
原声带不太好，可以用更好的音乐。我听了一会儿就关掉了。不过第一首对角色创建来说不错。
毫无作用的特质。
物品和部件种类贫乏，每艘飞船在部件方面开始看起来都一样。
所有飞船都有相同的UI？
有些特质或技能无法训练？
玩家不清楚什么时候需要付费。
新角色没有针对费用的“缓冲”，意味着你花时间创建的第一个角色100%会白费，应该能够“预先”保存已经创建好的、拥有相同父母等的角色。
更改你的姓氏不会影响你的出身。
我得到的所有“母亲”看起来都像男人，测试了8/10次，长相奇怪的“父亲”也一样。为什么要分配父母呢？他们似乎丝毫不影响你的故事？角色创建选项有限，总的来说尤其是女性的选项很糟糕，我试玩了几次，有一次给了我一个女性角色，在浪费时间创建角色后我意识到它只是换了一张不同的脸，放在默认男性身体上看起来有点滑稽。但总体而言它很欠缺，你甚至无法创建一个看起来像加载画面里的角色……甚至看起来“正常”的都不行。
你飞船的贷款系统似乎有点奇怪？你可以贷款买一艘800,000美元的飞船，但不能贷款买一艘80,000美元加一些额外东西比如装备的？或者一张执照？我不知道，老兄。事情说不通，在一艘飞船的描述中提到你曾在它上面工作过……为什么你不能在最便宜的飞船上工作？
漫长的保存时间是个问题。
角色创建有时很烦人，“寻找飞船”应该
不要在你下次查看时再次显示同一艘飞船，即使这会增加更多时间。
NPC会偷你的物品？物品消失？不得不重新加载，因为像我的头盔这样的核心物品消失了。
卸载你飞船上的部件，它们却出现在飞船外面……严重问题，因为根本没有办法出去？甚至从港口也不行？


我试着享受这款游戏，因为它似乎具备了一款我会喜欢的游戏的所有元素，但至少目前它是半生不熟的，我就是不喜欢。它甚至也没那么有深度，尽管乍一看似乎很复杂，一旦你玩上一小会儿，它其实是一款非常简单的游戏。

尽管如此，我仍然认为在经过一些更新后这会是一款好游戏，不幸的是，据我所见，以目前的开发速度，至少需要3年才能达到我认为这款游戏可玩的程度。

items.text:
when i played the demo, years ago, i was left with a... pretty bad first impression.

the controls were wonky, the user interface was opaque, and i couldn't really tell what i was meant to be doing.

it left enough of an impression on me that even as early access progressed, even as additional updates rolled out, even as it went on sale, even as one of my friends played it and reported on what those updates played like, i kept going "..... i dunno."

then after 0.14 hit, something happened in my social circles: people started playing the game, and i got a [i]wildly[/i] different impression on the state of the game than i did even just from 0.13, the very previous update.

with the addition of venus, there was somewhere to strive to get [i]to[/i]. with the rework of the reactor system, there was something to strive to [i]have[/i]. these elements, along with a lot of other adjustments and fixes, helped provide a better framing that let all of the systems work of the previous updates suddenly be recontextualized, and now, as if by magic, we went from "a kinda interesting simulation, i guess" to [b]an actual game[/b].

is the ui still kinda opaque? yeah. are there weird systems interactions that are counterintuitive? oh yeah. are there bugs? most definitely.

but the progress i'm seeing makes me believe that the team has a better understanding of what they need to clean up for the upcoming 1.0 release, and i wanna see it happen.

当我多年前玩这个演示版时，我留下的第一印象……相当糟糕。

操作很别扭，用户界面晦涩难懂，我根本搞不清自己该做什么。

它给我留下的印象如此之深，以至于即使抢先体验不断推进，即使额外更新陆续推出，即使它开始打折，即使我的一个朋友玩了它并反馈了那些更新的游玩体验，我一直都在说“..... 我不知道。”

然后0.14版本发布后，我的社交圈里发生了一些事：人们开始玩这个游戏，而我对游戏状态的印象与仅仅从0.13，也就是上一个更新中得到的印象[i]截然不同[/i]。

随着金星的加入，有了一个可以努力[i]前往[/i]的地方。随着反应堆系统的重做，有了可以努力[i]拥有[/i]的东西。这些元素，连同许多其他调整和修复，帮助提供了一个更好的框架，让之前所有更新的系统工作突然被重新赋予了意义，而现在，仿佛魔法一般，我们从“一个还算有趣的模拟，我猜”变成了[b]一个真正的游戏[/b]。

用户界面还是有点晦涩吗？是的。有没有奇怪的系统交互让人反直觉？哦，有的。有没有bug？绝对有。

但我看到的进步让我相信，团队更清楚地知道他们需要为即将到来的1.0发布清理什么，而我想看到它实现。

items.text: It's not a bad game by any means but it has so many stuff going on at the same time and there is no pacing. You get bombarded by everything at the same time which is a nightmare. Even after playing it for some time you still have no idea whats going on. You create a character with 0 idea whats going on you get on your ship with 0 idea of whats going on. You start figuring stuff out while scavenging. You come back to the station still not knowing what you should do. Is the amount you made any good. Do i upgrade the ship. Do i keep the money for the debt? Is there a docking fee? What's an eva? Why and where do i charge it? What is a shuttle? Why is ui design so complicated? What the ♥♥♥♥ is going on with the very complicated and retarded dialogue systems. Do i dismantle or just bring the stuff in. Why is navigating the space sucks so much etc. There is a ♥♥♥♥ ton of problems. Very hostile against new player. If they don't abandon the game they will eventually figure out stuff and it will become a great game. Right now if you know what you are doing its fun but if you are not ready to watch a couple hours of videos to get ready and you are not okay with 1 mistake ruining your whole game. Don't even try it. You can softlock the game by just playing it and lose an hour of progress.

items.text:
( Reviewing Ver 0.13 7/25/24, game will likely have changed with updates )

Controls 7 / 10 ( Think Old School Retro without the game pad )
Depth 9.5 / 10 ( Very Few games go this in depth, and even less do it this well though it could use some better GUI's )
Music 8 / 10 (it's pretty good, not AAA, but definalty A, now if only it didn't randomly stop playing for long periods. )
Sound effects 5 / 10 ( Some of these are ear grating and realisticly annoying meaning you'd better pay attention to that alarm that's bugging you or you might end up dead really soon )
Difficulty 9.0 / 10 (Expect to die alot until you learn, though things do get easier)
Newb Friendliness 2 / 10 ( nope expect to die alot )
Tutorial 5 / 10 ( it's there at first, just enough to get you into a position where you can die and then your on your own, Have Fun ^_^ , did i mention the tutorial sets you up to die the first time you fly?)

**The tutorial starts ship flight by having you burn up an excessive amount of your fuel before sending you out to start your first scrap, but it leaves you with so little fuel that on your return trip you are almost certain to run out before returning to dock. I've practiced several runs to see about finding a way, perhaps if i could minimize the fuel usage... My success rate for that has been roughly 1/3 and only survive if choosing the nearest scrap heap that a patrol is sure to find me scrapping and fine me 15,000 credits for the 5,000 credit license you can't really afford on your first run. Unless you let your character reach 30-40 years old before starting which carries it's own deadly problems. Just saying though a tutorial shouldn't sabotage you. That's just EVIL !**

This game is for those who like overcoming hard Challenges, sometimes blatantly unfair ones in a dystopian society. if that's not you move on.

This game is a challenging Shipbuilding / ship-scrapping game in which your character is born on an asteroid with pathetic gravity and poor personal health find themselves in a dire situation and hoping to make a better situation for themselves they dream about owning their own ship, going where they please, and earning by scrapping. It is a Dystopian Future with semi-realistic technologies. Vanilla game has a harsh economy and more than likely you will either have to start out with a large debt you struggle to keep up the payments on for your first ship or you will end up a wanted criminal, take your pick but be warned escaping the law isn't as easy as you might expect from most space games as all starter ships are limited in range, speed, and distance. They also tend to lack the tools needed to sustain the life of your crew, even basic things like a toilet and sink are considered luxuries not found on starter vessels.

This ships are highly customize-able with enough time and effort and money..... expect to die... ALOT..
Think your safe because you made it to your ship.. think again...

（评测版本 0.13 7/25/24，游戏很可能已随更新发生变化）

操控 7 / 10（想象一下没有游戏手柄的老派复古风格）
深度 9.5 / 10（很少有游戏能达到这种深度，能做到这么好的就更少了，尽管它可以用一些更好的图形界面）
音乐 8 / 10（相当不错，不是3A级别，但绝对是A级，要是它不会随机长时间停止播放就好了。）
音效 5 / 10（其中一些刺耳且现实得令人烦躁，意味着你最好注意那个烦你的警报，否则你可能很快就会死掉）
难度 9.0 / 10（在你学会之前，预计会死很多次，不过事情确实会变得容易些）
新手友好度 2 / 10（不行，预计会死很多次）
教程 5 / 10（一开始是有的，刚好够把你带到一个会死的位置，然后你就得靠自己了，玩得开心 ^_^，我有没有提到教程会让你第一次飞行时就注定要死？）

**教程开始飞船飞行时，会让你烧掉过量的燃料，然后才把你送出去开始你的第一次打捞，但它留给你的燃料少得可怜，以至于在返程途中你几乎肯定会在返回码头之前耗尽燃料。我练习了好几次，想看看能不能找到办法，也许如果我能把燃料消耗降到最低……我这样做的成功率大约是1/3，而且只有选择最近的废料堆才能活下来，而巡逻队肯定会发现我在打捞，并因为你那第一次航行中根本负担不起的5,000信用点许可证而罚你15,000信用点。除非你让你的角色在开始前活到30-40岁，而这又带有它自己致命的麻烦。只是说一句，教程不应该坑你。那简直就是邪恶！**

这款游戏适合那些喜欢克服艰难挑战的人，有时是在反乌托邦社会中那些公然不公平的挑战。如果你不是这种人，那就别玩了。

这是一款富有挑战性的造船/拆船游戏，你的角色出生在一颗重力可怜、个人健康状况糟糕的小行星上，发现自己身处绝境，并希望为自己创造更好的处境，梦想拥有自己的飞船，去自己想去的地方，靠打捞赚钱。这是一个拥有半写实技术的反乌托邦未来。原版游戏经济严酷，你很可能要么一开始就背负一大笔债务，为你的第一艘飞船苦苦维持还款，要么最终成为一名通缉犯，随你选，但要注意，逃脱法律并不像你可能从大多数太空游戏中预期的那样容易，因为所有初始飞船在航程、速度和距离上都有限。它们往往还缺乏维持船员生命所需的工具，甚至连马桶和水槽这样的基本设施都被视为初始飞船上没有的奢侈品。

这些飞船在足够的时间、精力和金钱下是高度可定制的……预计会死……很多次……
你以为到了自己的飞船上就安全了……再想想……

items.text: Very addictive if you're into this style of game. The trailers and description would have you believe that you need to understand rocket science, and if you do one wrong thing you die, but it's far less harsh as it presents. It is way more complex than an average simulation game, and the agency of having knobs to turn and buttons to press scratches a primordial itch. It still has a ways to go as it's early access. There's a lot of UI nonsense, and the sheer amount of information it shoves down your throat can be daunting, with durabilities, gas content, the TYPES of gases flowing, types of fuel, the inventory design etc. Also the tutorial will leave you hanging on certain things, you will have to discover them on your own thru trial and error. It is also HEAVILY narrative driven, example if you're in combat, you get prompts, and you will take turns with that stuff, while it tells you stuff like "you attempt to swing heavily at person," and then "Person's armor is barely scratched." But it's a very enjoyable experience so far and the dev seems pretty dedicated to improving and adding thigns.
items.text_zh: 如果你喜欢这种风格的游戏，会非常上瘾。预告片和描述会让你以为你需要懂火箭科学，做错一件事就会死，但实际上远没有它呈现的那么严苛。它比一般的模拟游戏复杂得多，而拥有可以拧的旋钮和可以按的按钮所带来的掌控感，挠到了某种原始的痒处。它还有很长的路要走，因为还在抢先体验阶段。有很多UI上的乱七八糟的东西，而且它硬塞给你的信息量之大可能让人望而生畏，包括耐久度、气体含量、流动的气体种类、燃料类型、物品栏设计等等。另外，教程会在某些事情上让你悬着，你得通过反复试错自己去发现。它还极度依赖叙事驱动，比如你在战斗中会收到提示，然后你要和这些东西轮流进行，同时它会告诉你诸如“你试图重重地挥向那个人”，然后“那个人的护甲几乎没被划伤”。但到目前为止，这是非常愉快的体验，开发者似乎也非常致力于改进和添加东西。

items.text:
I would not recommend currently. Clunky controls, no explanations in any meaningful way, UI elements that should exist don't. When something doesn't work there is no explanation of why you would be unable to do whatever it is what you were trying to do. For example I tried building a bed, it just wouldn't, there is no info on why i could not, it doesn't show material i would need to do the build. Same when you are repairing or restoring things. There is no info about what skills or traits actually affect any part of what you can do. The gig system is really clunky. So in the eight hours I made 3 or 4 characters trying to figure things out, I was able to get a small passenger ship and I figured how to repair and restore the entire ship. Took awhile, but when i was ready I could not figure out how to pick up passengers. The inventory system is similar to Project Zomboid with the addition of dragging things (which I like.) 

Some Good things though, the AI of the character is pretty good. It will search for the right tool and materiel when repairing or restoring when putting it on Auto Behavior. I think it also will eat or drink automatically. There is a Tag system which indicates certain things which was a bit helpful, for the character it wasn't great all of the characters I made had like 30 different tags so it was confusing, The ability to make a ship is cool, I personally would have preferred during the life timeline you for your "Resume" that you could be collecting parts to build your own tiny ship and then you can build up from there. Doing that would teach you about each part and what and how to set up each of the ships. Cause it's weird that you spend 10 years or so as a ship breaker and you don't know about the parts of the ship and what they do. 

I feel like with more time this will be an amazing game. It's just needs some of the clunk taken off (the navigation system would be one that could be a bit more streamlined, you are in the future so it doesn't need to be so complicated to fly the ship.)
items.text_zh:
目前我不推荐。操作笨拙，没有任何有意义的解释，应该存在的UI元素却不存在。当某些东西不工作时，没有解释为什么你无法做你正在尝试做的事情。例如，我尝试建造一张床，就是不行，没有信息说明为什么我不能，它不显示我建造所需的材料。修理或恢复东西时也一样。没有信息说明哪些技能或特质实际影响你能做的任何部分。零工系统真的很笨拙。所以在我玩的八小时里，我创建了3到4个角色试图弄清楚事情，我能够获得一艘小型客船，并且我弄明白了如何修理和恢复整艘船。花了一段时间，但当我准备好时，我无法弄清楚如何接乘客。库存系统类似于Project Zomboid，增加了拖拽物品的功能（我喜欢这个）。

不过有些好的方面，角色的AI相当不错。在修理或恢复时，当设置为自动行为时，它会寻找正确的工具和材料。我认为它也会自动吃喝。有一个标签系统，指示某些东西，这有点帮助，对于角色来说不是很好，我创建的所有角色都有大约30个不同的标签，所以很混乱。建造船只的能力很酷，我个人更希望在生活时间线中，你的“简历”可以收集零件来建造你自己的微型船，然后你可以从那里开始建造。这样做会教你每个部件以及如何设置每艘船。因为很奇怪的是，你作为拆船工工作了大约10年，却不知道船的部件以及它们的作用。

我觉得如果有更多时间，这将是一款很棒的游戏。只是需要去掉一些笨拙之处（导航系统可以更精简一些，你是在未来，所以飞行船只不需要那么复杂。）

items.text:
The game gives absolutely no information to the player whatsoever about what traits do. It tells you you should take valuable parts of the ship, yet the uninstall takes ages. Upon further research, you require a skill (which you can only guess at if not using the wiki) to improve the time it takes. You start with a pressure suit, which requires you to go back and forth for more air while you dismantle derelicts. While autotask does indeed make the character go on its own, both for uninstalling components and going back to the ship for more air, having high CO2 inside the pressure suit sets the game speed to 1x, effectively making you unable to automate things properly unless you enjoy playing in real time speed.

Some UIs in the game are pretty good to look at, while some contain default Unity slide bars and fully black backgrounds (see refuel UI), many other UIs look out of place and have many different styles, as if each one was made by a different person with different ideas.

This is definitely not a 1.0 game, and I doubt it'll ever be by looking at the pace at which updates are released.
items.text_zh:
游戏完全没有向玩家提供任何关于特质有什么作用的信息。它告诉你要拿走飞船上有价值的部件，但拆卸却要花很久。进一步查资料后才发现，你需要一项技能（不用wiki的话只能靠猜）来缩短所需时间。你一开始穿着压力服，这要求你在拆解废弃飞船时来回跑以补充空气。虽然自动任务确实能让角色自行行动，无论是拆卸部件还是回飞船补充空气，但压力服内二氧化碳过高会把游戏速度设为1倍，实际上让你无法正常自动化，除非你喜欢以实时速度游玩。

游戏里有些UI看起来相当不错，而有些则包含默认的Unity滑动条和全黑背景（见加油UI），还有许多其他UI显得格格不入，风格五花八门，仿佛每一个都是由不同的人带着不同想法做出来的。

这绝对不是一款1.0版本的游戏，而且从更新发布的速度来看，我怀疑它永远都不会是。

items.text:
[b] *Остро-навты* [/b]

Когда я взялся играть в ЭТО... мне сразу вспомнился набивший аскомину NMS. Но, обо всём по порядку!
Как всегда, присаживайтесь, заварите чайку или кофейку...
Сартуем!!!

[b] *A long time ago, in a galaxy far-far away...* [/b]

Пару слов о разработке.
Натыкался я на новости о старте проекта ещё году, наверно в 20-м, точнее не скажу. Было интервью с разработчиками NEO Scavenger и кто-то из отцов обмолвился, что изначально движ должен был происходить в космосе, но опыт, механики, молодо-зелено... Штош... Сейчас парни со скрипом, долго, муторно, с болью в душе (видимо), возможно с надрывом пилят очередное своё детище. И посмотреть тут есть на что, я вам доложу. Стопицот механик, необычное управление, интересные взаимодействия, но главное... запомните... [b] ЭТО НЕ БАЛДРА-3 [/b]!!! Вашу-ж мать... Или нет?! ))) 
Будем посмотреть, а пока идут технические работы, поиграем и оценим что-же получается.

[b] *Сколько лет прошло, холод жжёт в груди...* [/b]
[b] *Эй Земля алло! Я Вояджер один!* [/b]

Ганимед.
Вы начинаете как молодой, рядовой сотрудник корпорации по утилизации брошенных/сломанных космосудов. В ваши обязанности будет вхо... стоп!

Дубль два. Поехали.
Начало.
Мало кто вспомнит сейчас старый добрый Jagged Alliance 2, но именно там я впервые познакомился с генерацией персонажа через "текстовое тестирование". Собственно, здесь, вы не выбираете себе набор трэйтов, перков, скиллов, не выбираете "класс" персонажа. Вы родились в далёком космосе, выросли, вам 18. И перед вами открытый мир и мечта о свободе и собственном корабле. Учитесь, тусуйтесь, копите деньги, влипайте в истории вынося оттуда ценный опыт, обрастая связями, обретая друзей или заклятых врагов. Вас может покидать по "местам не столь отдалённым"... Но учтите! Время... Время - единственный и самый ценный ваш ресурс. Здоровье подорвётся, годы уйдут и многое станет в тягость. То, что вы можете намутить в 20, в 40 намутить уже... трудновато будет... физически. Поэтому рассчитывайте как вы планируете потратить отведённое вам время, не растратьте его попусту.

Вы сами генерируете биографию персонажа через текстовые события, резюмируете итог, покупаете судно, естественно в кредит, а как без этого, проклятые корпорации высосут из вас все соки, перетрут и используют, а затем сварят из вас белковую смесь! Ну... это в теории... Что-то я отвлёкся, продолжим.

[b] *Гагарин! Я вас любила! Ой! На-на-на-на!* [/b]

Игровое поле и интерфейсы.

Ох и шатал-дремал я это всё! Вам просто придётся привыкать. Аутентичный интерфейс знакомый игрокам в NEO Scavenger, отдалённо напоминает суперхит для low-grade PC или задротов вроде меня - Cataclysm:DDA или Cataclysm:BN (рекомендую ознакомиться с вопросом). СЛОЖНА! Честно... блин... 
Хотите управлять кораблём? Извольте ознакомиться с приборной панелью "Polaris" и... текстовым мануалом. Хотите понять как сделать ваш корабль не капсулой с вакуумом, а обитаемым островком с атмосферой? Будте любезны, вот мануал по окружайке (Environment)!
Инвентари - головная боль! Они нифига не такие удобные как в NEO, да и вообще не удобные, но тут сложности с реализацией механик сборки и запила корабля, торговли, боёвки. Парни поднимают такой пласт разработки шо пипец. И это заслуживает похвалы и уважения. Учиться, рисковать, строить новое, отличное от основного рынка - дорогого стоит.

[b] *И мы бросаемся в костёр,* [/b] 
[b] *Нам и в аду не будет жарко!* [/b]
[b] *На этом свете нас спасёт* [/b]
[b] *лишь МОЛОТ, СВАРКА и БОЛГАРКА!* [/b]

Основной геймплей.

Всё построено на бомжевании. У вас есть магазины на станциях, но эти магазы скупают лом и не продадут вам, скажем... Двигатели. Или батареи. Или нужные именно для вашего судна полы... Да много чего они вам не продадут, зато с удовольствием купят всё, или почти всё, что вы им приволокёте. Потому что вам нужно именно отволочь к прилавку скажем... Реактор, который вы скрутили вооон с той светящейся точки на карте. Единственное, что станция для вас гарантированно предоставит - услуги докинга, дозаправки, подзарядки... не бесплатно, конечно же. Да господи! Вы вообще цены на топливо видели?! Это просто грабёж! Ползарплаты на заправке оставляю, прихожу кнопки подавить, и на тебе, страссье, давненько не видал таких циферок! А так же не стоит забывать про кредит на вашу "ласточку" иначе а-та-та! Мрак.

Для того чтобы работать в открытом космосе нужен надёжный скафандр, стартовый гермокостюм для вакуума подойдёт, но не для вылазок в открытый космос, учтите это. Также вам нужны инструменты для работы, собственно - резаки, отвёртки, паяльники и прочие слесарские штуки. И поверьте - выбрать есть из чего.

Второй вариант заработка - перекупы. Всмысле... Вы тот самый перекуп, который: "Да не бита, не крашена, в ДТП не участвовала, документы чистые!". Есть брокер на станции, есть вариант выкупить брошенку, подлатать, загнать обратно по увеличенной стоимости, всё в ваших руках.

[b] *А звёзды тем не менее, а звёзды тем не менее, всё ближе, но всё так же холодны...* [/b]

Я намеренно не пишу тут об очевидных проблемах раннего доступа - оптимизация хромает, некоторые механики и код работают хрен-пойми как, глючат NPC, хаулеры в космосе носятся как твой сосед на "четырке". Важнее всего атмосфера и сам геймплей. Если вспомнить парней из Hello Games, они просто релизнули игру, внимание, РЕЛИЗНУЛИ. Так что, скорее всего парни понимают и используют опыт коллег - основная задача: выработать основу, которую потом можно улучшать до бесконечности.

Чем был NMS на релизе?
Каким был визуал и функционал Factorio на момент взлёта популярности?
Количество функциональных блоков на момент Early access в Space Engineers?
Вы точно уверенны в Star Citizen?
Сколько разрабатывалась Barotrauma?

Я вам приведу ещё с десяток проектов на которые, в теории, тоже можно было бы махнуть рукой, но в которые играют и по сей день...

[b] *Мне от вас, пессимистов, тошно! Все беды из-за нытья "вонючего" вашего...* [/b]

В данный момент ведётся активная разработка.
Как это можно видеть по билдам? Например сейчас уже есть огнетушители, но! Боевые суда и симуляция огня, судя по дорожной карте, будут ещё о-го-го как не скоро. На носу апдейт всей системы игры, новая механика, интерпланетарные перелёты, новые двигатели, новые вызовы. Я считаю что команда нуждается в поддержке именно сейчас, когда формируется кор-гейм. Кроме того, на данном этапе разработки игра вполне подойдёт, чтобы скоротать пару вечеров за лутанием и распилом дереликтов - процесс залипательный.

С учётом стоимости - рекомендую к покупке.
items.text_zh:
[b] *太空流浪汉* [/b]

当我开始玩这个的时候……我立刻想起了那个让人腻歪的《无人深空》。不过，咱们还是按顺序来吧！
一如既往，请坐下，泡杯茶或咖啡……
开整！！！

[b] *很久很久以前，在一个遥远的星系……* [/b]

关于开发说几句。
我大概在20年的时候，可能吧，更准确我说不准，就撞见过关于项目启动的新闻。当时有对《NEO Scavenger》开发者的采访，某位元老提到，最初引擎本该设定在太空，但经验、机制、年轻稚嫩……好吧……现在这帮人正吱吱嘎嘎、漫长、烦闷、带着灵魂深处的痛苦（大概吧），也许还带着撕裂感，打磨着他们的又一个心血结晶。而且我得告诉你们，这里确实有看头。成百上千的机制，不寻常的操作，有趣的互动，但最重要的是……记住……[b] 这不是《博德之门3》 [/b]！！！去你妈的……或者不是？！）））
咱们走着瞧，趁现在还在技术施工，先玩玩看，评估一下到底做出来个啥。

[b] *多少年过去了，寒冷灼烧着胸膛……* [/b]
[b] *嘿地球，你好！我是旅行者一号！* [/b]

木卫三。
你一开始是某家回收废弃/损坏太空船公司的年轻普通员工。你的职责将包括……停！

第二条。走起。
开头。
现在很少有人还记得老好人《铁血联盟2》，但正是在那里，我第一次接触到通过“文本测试”来生成角色。其实在这里，你不选择一套特质、专长、技能，也不选择角色的“职业”。你出生在遥远的太空，长大了，你18岁。你面前是开放世界，以及对自由和拥有自己飞船的梦想。学习、混日子、攒钱、卷入各种故事并从中带走宝贵经验，积累人脉，结交朋友或死敌。你可能会被送进“不那么遥远的地方”……但注意！时间……时间是你唯一且最宝贵的资源。健康会垮掉，岁月会流逝，很多事情会变得力不从心。你20岁能搞到的东西，40岁再搞就已经……有点难了……身体上。所以好好盘算你打算怎么花掉分配给自己的时间，别白白浪费。

你自己通过文本事件生成角色传记，总结结果，买船，当然是贷款，不然怎么行，该死的公司会把你榨干，揉碎，利用完，然后把你熬成蛋白混合物！嗯……理论上如此……我有点跑题了，继续。

[b] *加加林！我爱过您！哎哟！呐-呐-呐-呐！* [/b]

游戏场景和界面。

哎呀，我可被这一切折腾得够呛！你只能去习惯。熟悉《NEO Scavenger》玩家的那种原汁原味界面，隐约让人想起低配PC或像我这种硬核宅的超级神作——《Cataclysm:DDA》或《Cataclysm:BN》（建议了解一下）。难！说实话……妈的……
想操控飞船？那就请去熟悉“Polaris”仪表盘和……文本手册。想搞明白怎么让你的飞船不再是个真空胶囊，而是有大气层的可居住小岛？劳驾，这是环境（Environment）手册！
物品栏——头疼！它们根本不像《NEO》里那么方便，而且总体来说也不方便，但这里有组装和打造飞船、贸易、战斗机制实现上的困难。这帮人扛起的开发量简直吓人。这值得称赞和尊重。学习、冒险、建造不同于主流市场的新东西——这很了不起。

[b] *而我们扑向火堆，* [/b] 
[b] *就算在地狱我们也不会觉得热！* [/b]
[b] *在这个世界上能救我们的* [/b]
[b] *只有大锤、焊接和角磨机！* [/b]

主要玩法。

[b] *然而星星依旧，然而星星依旧，越来越近，却依旧那么寒冷……* [/b]

Personally I love this game already.  However I'm a weirdo who can get past brutally awkward UIs and crazy amounts of jank to see a game with a cool idea and a lot of promise.

At this point, Aug 2023, it's just promise and needs a lot of content before I'd recommend it to anyone I know.  Fixing the UI and the jank would also be good, but for now I think a big part of it is that there just isn't all that much to do in the game before you've seen it all

Dec 2024 and I'm updating my review comments.  There seems to be more to do, which is good, but I'm also encountering way more bugs of the "reload from save" variety.  Having to reload also makes the long load times more painful.

At this point I'm reasonably certain the game is doomed and that makes me sad, because I love the theme, the high detail, and a lot of what they've done with this game as a concept

Aug 2026 and it's hit 1.0, the bugs are pretty well resolved, however I think ultimitely it's still a no recommend from me, ambitious game but the jank factor is too high.  Load times are still too long and it just feels a lot more like work than fun

在现在这个时间点，2023年8月，它只是有潜力，还需要大量内容，我才会把它推荐给我认识的任何人。修复UI和那些粗糙之处也会是好事，但就目前而言，我认为很大一部分原因是，在你把所有内容都看过一遍之前，游戏里实在没有太多可做的事。

2024年12月，我正在更新我的评测评论。似乎有更多可做的事了，这很好，但我也遇到了更多那种“从存档重新加载”的bug。不得不重新加载也让漫长的加载时间更加痛苦。

在这一点上，我相当确定这款游戏注定要完蛋，这让我很难过，因为我喜欢这个主题、高细节，以及他们在这款游戏的概念上所做的很多事。

2026年8月，它已经达到1.0，bug已经解决得相当好了，不过我认为最终它仍然是我不会推荐的作品，一款雄心勃勃的游戏，但粗糙程度太高了。加载时间仍然太长，而且感觉更像是在工作而不是在娱乐。

As someone who played a bit of N.E.O Scavenger I gotta say I'm a little disappointed. There seems to be some decent bones here and I'm sure that once there is more content and polish that this will become a great game. Just right now it's lacking in clarity, especially in the U.I department.

At one point in my 90 minute play session after un-docking from a wreck, my ship just would not produce any thrust. After looking through the in game ship manual and starring at ship panels for a while I simply could not determine the cause of it. I'm no stranger to cluttered U.I but I can't say I've been this stumped before. 

I'm not saying its a bad game by any means. This dev has a good history. But if your interested in this I would give it a while to add some more content and buff out some of the rough edges. Otherwise look at some guides online or in their discord before you start because the in-game resources are a little lacking at this time. This is another one of those times where I wish there was a halfway point on steam recommendations, but because of my experience and simply the current state of the game I unfortunately have to give it a negative recommendation which isn't an easy decision as I know this is a passionate dev.

There is  a bit of a learning curve but once you pass that it actually becomes a fun and unique game to play. The UI looks rough around the edges but the functionality is there. Love the game play loop of scavenging to get $ and creating a bigger better ship along with the quests you can take to switch things up. 
I admit it was a little frustrating at first but my advice for new players is to 

- Get the starter ship with the moderate safety rating, it will have all the parts to function well and its laid out neatly so its easy to see what goes where and why.

- Skim though the manuals, its tedious but helpful and with the new tutorials added id say it definitely helps with getting new players started with the basics. 

- First thing you should save for is the better space suit (the orange one) you can actually stay out in space longer and not have to worry about going back inside your own ship for air. 

- Your character will most definitely die every way possible when starting to learn the ropes so save and load often.

- Don't patch up and take an abandoned ship until you dabbled in modifying your own and also having all the necessities for a small ship (Oxygen, fuel, heating, cooling, etc). 

- Remember to save and constantly experiment especially when modifying your ship (try uninstalling parts one at time to see what happens)

For EA its definitely solid and enjoyable to play. I have'nt encountered any bugs yet but remember to save often (as with all EA games). Only thing i feel is missing is the ship combat. Not sure if the developers are planning on it but one can only hope.

我承认一开始有点令人沮丧，但我给新玩家的建议是

- 买那艘中等安全评级的初始飞船，它会拥有所有能良好运作的部件，而且布局整齐，所以很容易看出什么放在哪里以及为什么。

- 浏览一下手册，这很乏味但很有帮助，而且有了新加入的教程，我得说它肯定能帮助新玩家掌握基础。

- 你首先应该攒钱买的是更好的太空服（橙色那件），这样你实际上可以在太空里待更久，而不必担心要回到自己的飞船里呼吸空气。

- 在开始学习门道时，你的角色肯定会以各种可能的方式死掉，所以要经常保存和加载。

- 在你摸索过改装自己的飞船，并且拥有小型飞船所需的所有必需品（氧气、燃料、供暖、冷却等）之前，不要修补并接收一艘废弃飞船。

- 记住要保存，并不断实验，尤其是在改装你的飞船时（试着一次卸载一个部件，看看会发生什么）

对于EA阶段来说，它绝对扎实且玩起来很愉快。我还没遇到任何bug，但记住要经常保存（就像所有EA游戏一样）。我唯一觉得缺少的是飞船战斗。不确定开发者是否在计划这个，但人只能抱有希望。

items.text:
Entertaining, for early access.
-Fun to learn while dying type game
-Awesome character generation, repeats after a few times
-Fixing/building your ship is fun while it is breaking down
-Cops coming for you to check on your license is funny
-Crew social is very interesting, buggy, but interesting

Really needs a lot more work though - bugs from 1/12/23:
-After visiting a few derelicts and having a lot of stuff on your ship, it will start becoming choppy/low fps
-The orders management is cool, yet fails/crashes a lot
-Inventory UI is horrible, cannot change the size of the huge text, you accidentally click off one of the tiny inventory boxes you move, which is both annoying and sometimes rarely useful
-Social UI is horrible, cannot change the size of the small text
-Trade UI is horrible, have to scroll every time you open a sub-list
-Esc key, escapes everything except right click menu
-The crew will constantly interrupt you, repair a hole in the hull, doesn’t matter
-No good way to get crew to stop interrupting aside from mod, which removes it completely
-Crew will constantly go outside without helmets and die lock doors if you could get all the codes
-Crew dying on another ship, you cannot drag them to your ship, fire them and leave them to die (or extra eva suit)
-Cops will ram you
-Bugs/lacking in many ship systems, airlocks are almost pointless since you cannot automate them and lose air fast. (sure you can manually vacuum the space, but the manual controls are full screen for a tiny panel and a just get annoying after a while)
-Nav station won’t list all door codes, and you have guess which door is which code
-Lots of skills are useless, some do a little, 4 of them do a lot
-Making money/economy is weird - you can get a lot of stuff, but cannot sell it all. If you have a loan, you will be bogged down in bills, store refreshes every 4 shifts, but you have to pay the loan every shift... So you get the ship that doesn't have a loan and then it becomes pointless
-Yeah you can jettison stuff.... one at a time.... 100s of trash.... ugh

Wishes: 
-multiplayer, or at least better crew. 
-Easy way to make ships and add them to the game without modding. 
-Simple switch automation (at least a proximity switch)
-By the time you find the Cart, you really don’t need the cart
-Simple crafting - cart, change 02 sensor to N2, cart, blue light to red light, cart

Tldr: After 100+ hours played, the bugs will beat you into not wanting to play this awesome game. Worth $20, yea

TLDRl; A game built around time sinks, not bad mechanics, Early Access will end as abandonware (mark my words). Only buy this game on sale and return it quick if you have the slightest dislike. 

After restarting my character creation a couple times I had some good luck and made some money. I found a sweet derelict ship and I want to make it my home. I could not figure out how. While my character was repairing something, I tabbed out and opened a window to research how to claim a ship. I heard the proximity alarm and a ship crashed into me and blew out a wall near my character - killing him. 10 hours wasted. This was not the first time other ships have ignored self preservation and tried to drive in a straight line. This game feels like there is 1/10 of the content there should be. It feels unusually incomplete. "It is Early Access" you might say. It feels like even less than Early Access. As mentioned above only buy on sale and return it quick if you feel uneasy. Its not you, its the game. I am past the return window, so this game and my character will just be left for dead...


Edit 1:OH I HATE THIS GAME SOMETIMES. Another collision (with nothing on the map) killed my next character since my review. He was up to about 500,000 in cash and I just found a nice ship, when I hear the proximity alarm, then bang something hit me. Check the map, nothing. Bang, bang, bang, bang, something hitting me. Bang, bang, bang, bang, wall gone. Bang, bang, bang dead...

Edit 2: I decided to hire a crew member just to hang out and talk with, and to get some help. I finished up my business at the station. Repairing, selling, and rebuilding part of my ship. I undocked and headed for the next scrap ship and I noticed my crew wasn't moving. Since the floors of my ship are so cluttered, I moved some stuff and saw my crew mate laying on the ground. I do not know how to get the details of the character, but I main toon says something like "... something appears to be wrong with ***** [crewmember]". They are just laying on the ground. Dead or dying would be my guess. I stripped them just to remove their pressure helm (why were they wearing a helmet). What a joke.

I came back to the game in may 2023 and ships still randomly crash into you and the menus and character interaction menus somehow got worse...

Edit 1/5/24 : This game is still a cash grab. It still has day one bugs of ships crashing into other ships. I figured I would try this game again and within the first 15 minutes of play on the VERY FIRST FREAKING STATION a ship collides with the station (or a docked ship I guess). And I am trying to work on my ship and all I hear is BANG, BEEP-BEEP, BANG, BEEP-BEEP, BANG, BEEP-BEEP, BANG, BEEP-BEEP, BANG, BANG, BEEP-BEEP, BANG, BEEP-BEEP, BANG, BEEP-BEEP, BANG, BEEP-BEEP, BANG. This game is going to go down in history, and not the good history.

Ostranauts has some promise, but the implementation leaves much to be desired. I loved its retro aesthetic and was looking forward to trying it out.  It's clear the developers are working for a "gritty" kind of experience, and it feels like it doesn't get there, and instead veers off into just "frustrating".

I like games that don't hold your hand, but Ostranauts goes to incredible lengths to be hard to understand. The user interface is slow, clumsy and counter-intuitive, and I felt like I was constantly fighting the UI. It's also clear the game wants to be "hard" in that it's difficult to achieve success- but it does that by simply throwing extremely frustrating and arbitrary obstacles in your path as opposed to adding challenging but reasonably obtainable goals to the gameplay.

For example: the in-game "police" can board your ship and issue you fines, which you have to pay before leaving the station next. But because the fines can be so large, you can't undock or do anything. In theory, there's a way to talk to an NPC that can let you undock, but if you can't figure out the bizarre conversation system, or you're just not lucky enough to get a successful roll on a conversational "gambit", he just tells you to get bent.

So you can end up stuck and locked into the station with no path forward to access the primary gameplay loop. Instead I was faced with possibly wandering around the station for who knows how long- and because navigating the station is also slow, clumsy and frustrating, that was not something I wanted to try- hoping to stumble into a possible solution.

The gameplay isn't challenging, it's just punishing and frustrating, and isn't fun. I really wanted it to be.

《Ostranauts》有一些潜力，但实现方面还有很多不足之处。我喜欢它的复古美学，并期待尝试一下。很明显，开发者们正在努力营造一种“粗粝”的体验，但感觉并没有达到那个效果，反而转向了单纯的“令人沮丧”。

我喜欢不手把手教你的游戏，但《Ostranauts》为了让人难以理解而费尽心机。用户界面缓慢、笨拙且反直觉，我感觉自己一直在和UI作斗争。同样明显的是，游戏想要“难”，即难以取得成功——但它是通过在你前进的道路上简单地抛出极其令人沮丧和随意的障碍来实现的，而不是在游戏玩法中添加具有挑战性但合理可达成的目标。

例如：游戏中的“警察”可以登上你的飞船并给你开罚单，你必须在下次离开空间站之前支付。但由于罚款可能非常高，你无法脱离对接或做任何事情。理论上，有一种方法可以与一个NPC交谈，让他允许你脱离对接，但如果你搞不懂那套奇怪的对话系统，或者你只是运气不好，没有在对话“策略”中掷出成功，他就只会叫你滚蛋。

所以你最终可能会被困在空间站里，无法进入主要游戏循环。相反，我面临的是可能在空间站里漫无目的地游荡不知道多久——而且因为空间站内的导航也同样缓慢、笨拙且令人沮丧，那不是我想要尝试的事情——指望着偶然撞见一个可能的解决方案。

游戏玩法并不具有挑战性，它只是惩罚性和令人沮丧的，而且不好玩。我真的很希望它好玩。

items.text:
Edit for 14.3.15 (Actual gameplay time 100+ hours)

Strong recommend if you like emergent, sandboxy, systems-driven gameplay and don't mind the Early Access glitches and the (charmingly) janky UI. Less recommended if you want something polished with clearly-explained mechanics, and clearly signposted goals.

This game would probably appeal to players who have sunk hours into Dwarf Fortress, or who have spent hours breaking Bethesda games. If you enjoyed Neo Scavenger, you'll likely be interested in the similarities and differences in themes and design language of Ostranauts. It's about as close as I've got to a single-player SS13 (without other toxic players). 

I have been playing Ostranauts using Steam Family Sharing over other accounts, and so have somewhere north of 100 hours in it now at different stages of its development. I have just recently returned to it, and it has grown substantially in content and stability over that time. 

Bugs and glitches still occur - some of them amusing (the cop who magically teleported into my ship and then just sat in the corner writing letters home until I could drop her off at KLEG), some of them irritating. There are still a lot of systems and expected behaviours missing - for example, it would be great to see NPCs react when you dismantle the walls of their spaceship, rather than them just sitting down to browse social media until they suffocate. Despite this, this is very much a detailed and playable game despite EA status.

It also has a somewhat intimidating learning curve, compounded by the janky UI and some information not always being obvious or accessible to the player. (For example, "social combat" is still fairly opaque, and it would be nice to more clearly be able to quantify the impacts of acceleration on the condition of a spaceship, rather than trying to work this out through trial-and-error. Maybe the ability to install accelerometers or strain gauges.) That said, I found it's not quite as intimidating as it looks at first, but it may still be enough to turn off players who aren't willing to invest time in understanding the systems.
items.text_zh:
针对14.3.15版本的评测（实际游戏时间100+小时）

如果你喜欢涌现式、沙盒式、系统驱动的玩法，并且不介意抢先体验版的故障和（迷人地）笨拙的界面，强烈推荐。如果你想要打磨完善、机制解释清晰、目标明确标示的东西，则不太推荐。

这款游戏可能会吸引那些在《矮人要塞》里投入了数百小时的玩家，或者花了大量时间把贝塞斯达游戏玩坏的人。如果你喜欢《新拾荒者》，你很可能会对《奥斯特拉诺茨》在主题和设计语言上的相似与不同之处感兴趣。它大概是我最接近单人版SS13的体验（没有其他有毒玩家）。

我一直在通过Steam家庭共享在其他账号上玩《奥斯特拉诺茨》，所以现在在其不同开发阶段累计玩了100小时出头。我最近刚回到这款游戏，在这段时间里，它的内容和稳定性都有了大幅增长。

漏洞和故障仍然会出现——有些很有趣（那个警察神奇地传送进我的飞船，然后就坐在角落里写家信，直到我能把她送到KLEG），有些则令人恼火。仍然缺少很多系统和预期行为——例如，当你拆掉NPC飞船的墙壁时，如果能看到他们做出反应，而不是就那样坐下来刷社交媒体直到窒息，那就太好了。尽管如此，尽管处于EA状态，这仍然是一款非常细致且可玩的游戏。

它还有一条多少有些令人生畏的学习曲线，再加上笨拙的UI，以及有些信息并不总是对玩家显而易见或易于获取。（例如，“社交战斗”仍然相当不透明，如果能更清楚地量化加速度对飞船状况的影响，而不是靠反复试错来弄明白，那就好了。也许可以安装加速度计或应变仪。）话虽如此，我发现它并不像乍看之下那么令人生畏，但它可能仍然足以劝退那些不愿花时间理解这些系统的玩家。

The short answer is no, not in its present state. The UI is clunky, the game play is unbalanced and it needs a good tutorial as very little is self-evident. Also, the graphics are real bad (which to be fair, I knew going into the purchase).

More details: [spoiler] Even after watching several videos on YouTube while on pause (a mistake on my part - as game playtime still accrues while paused and caused me to surpass my refund time limit of 2 hours) and playing all three ships, I still found it difficult. I either died or became delinquent on the ship's mortgage note. It's no wonder these ships become available. The previous hapless soul either dies or gets his ship repo-ed and they just present it to the next fool in line. Depending on your starting ship, you either die because your free (smallest) ship is too small (i.e. doesn't have enough oxygen and/or space to allow you to salvage long enough to get or carry enough items to cover the docking fees at the salvage base) or your bigger ship has too big of a mortgage payment and not enough time to salvage enough to pay it. Where's the fun in that?

Even using the auto-dock cheat feature to save oxygen and battery/fuel reserves, (for those like me who's poor vector piloting skills keep the flight times dangerously long), I still manage to fail. It's a bit too frustrating for me. So unless you have a lot of patience or the developer introduces some sort of level of difficulty settings (beyond just the ability to slow and speed up time), I'd avoid this game, as it does not take into account the diversity of playing skills that a purchaser of this game may have.

It would help the player to know how long an action would take and how much oxygen time the ship/suit has, so we know if attempting a particular action would cause us to die before completing the action. As it is now (If I am understanding this game correctly and have not overlooked something that a tutorial could have helped with), we have no idea (or estimate) of how long a trip takes nor how much time a particular actions takes. So' it's no wonder we fail. [/spoiler]

简短的回答是：不，以目前的状态不行。用户界面笨拙，游戏玩法不平衡，而且需要一个好的教程，因为很少有东西是不言自明的。另外，画面真的很差（公平地说，我在购买前就知道这一点）。

更多细节：[剧透] 即使在暂停时看了几个YouTube视频（这是我的失误——因为暂停时游戏时间仍在累积，导致我超过了两小时的退款时限），并且玩遍了全部三艘飞船，我仍然觉得很难。我要么死了，要么拖欠了飞船的抵押贷款。难怪这些飞船会变得可用。之前那个倒霉蛋要么死了，要么飞船被收回，然后他们就直接把它交给下一个排队的傻瓜。取决于你的起始飞船，你要么因为你的免费（最小）飞船太小而死（即没有足够的氧气和/或空间让你打捞足够长的时间，以获得或携带足够的物品来支付打捞基地的停靠费），要么你的较大飞船有太高的抵押贷款还款额，而没有足够的时间打捞足够的东西来支付它。这有什么乐趣可言？

即使使用自动停靠作弊功能来节省氧气和电池/燃料储备（对于像我这样糟糕的矢量驾驶技术使飞行时间危险地过长的人），我仍然设法失败。这对我来说有点太令人沮丧了。所以除非你有很大的耐心，或者开发者引入某种难度设置（不仅仅是能够减慢和加快时间的能力），否则我会避开这款游戏，因为它没有考虑到这款游戏的购买者可能拥有的多样化游戏技能。

如果玩家能知道一个动作需要多长时间，以及飞船/宇航服还有多少氧气时间，那会很有帮助，这样我们就知道尝试某个特定动作是否会导致我们在完成动作之前死亡。就目前而言（如果我正确理解这款游戏，并且没有忽略某个教程本可以帮助解决的问题），我们不知道（也无法估计）一次旅行需要多长时间，也不知道某个特定动作需要多长时间。所以，难怪我们会失败。[/剧透]

items.text:
Rushed into 1.0 completely unfinished, barren of content, and full of bugs. The dev is ignoring this completely and deciding to delete and censor anything negative while only responding to positive comments which means they are well aware of what they've done.

The game is near undecipherable, there's crap scattered all over the floor and if you start playing the game you will have no idea what any of it is, everything's got 500 menus, all of them are just bare menus with no user friendly design. It's just ugly, along with the characters

One of the big selling points of this game was interacting with NPCS yet they're all just generic lifeless drones moving back and forth doing nothing, there's no dialogue just "You talked to this NPC, +1 to like meter" type slop and the dev said they prefer this system for some reason despite this being meant to be a NPC focused crew builder game. I warned them VERY early that this sims style approach to NPCS was NOT going to work, and was promptly ignored.

There's tons of bugs, my game crashed in the first hour of playing, I hope you enjoy running back and forth to your shuttle every 2 minutes to refill your oxygen while the game tells you that your character isn't horny for some reason. What is even the point of all these social systems and mood systems if your character is alone 99% of the time?

Game was launched to 1.0, dev admits it wasn't ready for 1.0 in the launch post, the game is still suffering from a major lack of content, there's only one supernatural event and all it does it ♥♥♥♥ meat all over ships, which makes me wonder why this is connected to Neoscavenger at all? Overall I don't see this game improving with post launch content, it seems like the dev wants the appearance of a depthy game without actually putting in the effort of making it or any of the mechanics engaging, a majority of the areas you visit are just empty ships with a pop up at the start but no actual content.

Dev only plans for one more major update, when this game needs about ten to be worth anything.

仓促地进入1.0版本，完全未完成，内容贫瘠，而且满是bug。开发者完全无视这一点，决定删除和审查任何负面内容，只回复正面评论，这意味着他们非常清楚自己做了什么。

游戏几乎无法理解，地板上到处都是垃圾，如果你开始玩这个游戏，你根本不知道那些东西是什么，所有东西都有500个菜单，全都是没有任何用户友好设计的简陋菜单。它很难看，角色也一样

这个游戏的一大卖点是与NPC互动，但他们全都是些毫无生气的无人机，来回移动什么也不做，没有对话，只有“你和这个NPC交谈了，好感度+1”之类的垃圾，开发者说他们出于某种原因更喜欢这个系统，尽管这本来应该是一个以NPC为核心的船员建造游戏。我很早就警告过他们，这种模拟人生式的NPC处理方式不会奏效，结果立刻被无视了。

有大量的bug，我在玩的第一小时游戏就崩溃了，我希望你喜欢每2分钟跑回你的穿梭机补充氧气，同时游戏还告诉你你的角色不知为何不性奋。如果你的角色99%的时间都是独自一人，这些社交系统和情绪系统到底有什么意义？

游戏发布到1.0，开发者在发布帖中承认它还没准备好进入1.0，游戏仍然严重缺乏内容，只有一个超自然事件，而它所做的只是把肉弄得满飞船都是，这让我想知道这到底为什么和Neoscavenger有关联？总的来说，我看不到这个游戏会通过发布后内容得到改善，开发者似乎想要一个看起来有深度的游戏，却没有真正付出努力去制作它，也没有让任何机制变得有趣，你去过的大多数区域都只是空荡荡的飞船，开始时弹出一个窗口，但没有任何实际内容。

开发者只计划再做一个大型更新，而这个游戏需要大约十个才能有点价值。

5 years after my first review i write another one.
- Finaly the game crashes like 10 times less then it was
- The game still annoys with dissapearing hull parts (floors, walls) when you try to contruct them no one item after another (EXAMPLE: you move a wall, place it somewhere and then in the mid of work just go to do something else, if you save-load, it will dissapear, unless you will build this wall to 100% complete)
- The game manual could be expanded so much better, for like in the begining to explain that without welding torch or similar tool, you can not build walls. I think new players will get pretty frustrated.
- Interface had almost no possitive or helpful changes (thank you for helping guides i guess... finaly)
- I have not got to more then begining, but after 4-5 hours of frustration i think this game will be interesting only to those who like explore and suffer in process)
-To play any good, you still need a community MOD "Performance Optimizer Mods" so your game would not clutter so much. THIS IS INSANE !

I don't recomend this game unless it will be not more then 5$ worth and with notification that new players WILL SUFFFER ! \m/

在我第一篇评测的5年后，我又写了一篇。
- 终于，游戏崩溃的次数比之前少了大概10倍
- 游戏仍然会因为当你试图一个接一个地建造船体部件（地板、墙壁）时它们消失而让人恼火（例如：你移动一堵墙，把它放在某个地方，然后在工作途中去做别的事情，如果你保存再加载，它就会消失，除非你把这堵墙建到100%完成）
- 游戏手册可以扩展得好得多，比如在开头解释如果没有焊接火炬或类似工具，你就不能建造墙壁。我认为新玩家会非常沮丧。
- 界面几乎没有任何积极或有帮助的改动（感谢帮助指南吧……终于）
- 我还没玩到开头之后更多内容，但在4-5小时的挫败之后，我认为这款游戏只会对那些喜欢探索并在过程中受苦的人感兴趣）
- 要想玩得稍微好一点，你仍然需要一个社区MOD“Performance Optimizer Mods”，这样你的游戏才不会那么杂乱。这太疯狂了！

我不推荐这款游戏，除非它价值不超过5美元，并且带有通知说明新玩家会受苦！\m/

Expanding your skills and money that you start with.  I hope this is expanded upon as it was a lot of fun.  The whole premise of being able to salvage wreckage and pull parts to use or sell is just fun. 
 Customize your ship and even bring crew on board to help you. With that said some of the UI  / menu's need overhauled, but It is still very EA and I think that is surely planned. If you like supporting EA titles, this is one I'd wager will come to fruition, but it will take its time and do it right.
